```{r}
#PERMANOVA
mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized_cs <- mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "sample_rowname")

merged_clinical_score <- left_join(clinical_score_cross, mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized_cs)

merged_clinical_score$group_score <- factor(merged_clinical_score$`Clinical score (0-5)`, 
                                                        levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5"))

merged_clinical_score <- merged_clinical_score %>%
    drop_na()

#overall
vegan::adonis2(merged_clinical_score[,10:63]~group_score, data = merged_clinical_score, na.action = na.omit, permutations = 999,method="bray") #0.144

#loop over all the possible clinical score comparisons 
groups <- unique(merged_clinical_score$group_score)
pair_combinations <- combn(groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)

results_cs <- map_dfr(pair_combinations, function(pair) {
  df_pair <- merged_clinical_score %>% filter(group_score %in% pair)
  adonis_res <- adonis2(
    df_pair[,10:63] ~ group_score,
    data = df_pair,
    permutations = 999,
    method = "bray"
  )
  tibble(
    group1 = pair[1],
    group2 = pair[2],
    pseudoF = adonis_res$F[1],
    p.value = adonis_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
})

results_cs %>%
gt() %>%
tab_header(title = "Clinical score comparisons")

write_csv(results_cs, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score/clinical_score_permanova_comparisons.csv")


#permanova with clinical score as a gradient
vegan::adonis2(merged_clinical_score[,10:63]~ as.numeric(group_score), data = merged_clinical_score, na.action = na.omit, permutations = 999,method="bray") #0.006


#check dispersion 
bd <- betadisper(
  vegdist(merged_clinical_score[, 10:63], method = "bray"),
  as.numeric(merged_clinical_score$group_score)
)
anova(bd)   #0.879


#is the increase in L.iners abundance a driver?
iners_abund <- merged_clinical_score$s__Lactobacillus_iners
cor.test(iners_abund, as.numeric(merged_clinical_score$`Clinical score (0-5)`), method = "spearman") #not significant so not the sole driver 

```

-   Global categorical PERMANOVA → nonsignificant

-   Pairwise tests → weak / inconsistent

-   Ordinal test → significant

-   No evidence of heterogeneity of dispersion across clinical scores

-   Group variances are essentially identical

-   PERMANOVA result is not an artefact of spread

The signal is continuous, not stepwise + not driven by dispersion -\> Bacterial community composition changes gradually with increasing clinical severity, rather than forming discrete clusters corresponding to clinical score categories. + Clinical severity captures a biological gradient that diagnostic labels do not

Gradient:

This asks a much simpler question:

Is there a consistent directional shift in composition as score increases?

This does not require:

-   separation between adjacent scores

-   clean clusters

-   non-overlapping groups

It only needs:

-   a weak but consistent trend

That’s why it detects a signal. Treating clinical score as a categorical variable tests for discrete microbiome states, whereas modeling it as an ordinal variable tests for a monotonic trend; our data support the latter but not the former.

## Aldex2 clinical score correlation with species

```{r}
#| label: aldex2-cs-species
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

########################################
# CORRELATION CLINICAL SCORE - SPECIES #
########################################

counts <- estimated_counts %>% as.data.frame()

counts <- counts %>%
filter(!is.na(svamp_ID))

counts <- counts %>%
column_to_rownames("svamp_ID")

counts <- counts %>%
dplyr::select(-c("after_kraken2_host_removal", "barcode_shotgun_swab"))

clinical_score_aldex <- merged_clinical_score %>%
dplyr::select(svamp_ID, `Clinical score (0-5)`)

setdiff(rownames(counts), merged_clinical_score$svamp_ID)

counts_filtered <- counts[match(merged_clinical_score$svamp_ID, rownames(counts)), ]

setdiff(rownames(counts_filtered), merged_clinical_score$svamp_ID)

counts_t <- t(counts_filtered)

x_clr <- aldex.clr(
  counts_t,
  mc.samples = 128,
  denom = "all",
  verbose = TRUE
)

setdiff(colnames(x_clr), clinical_score_aldex$svamp_ID)

clinical_score_aldex <- clinical_score_aldex %>%
column_to_rownames("svamp_ID")

clinical_score_vec <- clinical_score_aldex$`Clinical score (0-5)`

aldex_corr <- aldex.corr(
  x_clr,
  clinical_score_vec
)

aldex_corr <- aldex_corr %>%
rownames_to_column("Species")

aldex_corr %>%
gt()

#heatmap of the clinical score and the different species correlation 
heatmap_mat <- aldex_corr %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, spearman.erho) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Species") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mat <- aldex_corr %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, spearman.ep) %>%
  mutate(sig = spearman.ep < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(sig, Species) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Species") %>%
  as.matrix()

pretty_taxa_names <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("s__", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x)  
  x
}

rownames(heatmap_mat) <- pretty_taxa_names(rownames(heatmap_mat))
rownames(sig_mat) <- rownames(heatmap_mat)

png(
  filename = "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/heatmap/heatmap_clinical_score_species_correlation.png",
  width = 2000,
  height = 2000,
  res = 300
)

heatmap_cs_species <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  name = "Spearman r",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,    
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "italic"),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height,
                gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1, fill = NA))
    }
  },
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Spearman correlation (before FDR)")
)

dev.off() 

plot(heatmap_cs_species)
```

## Clinical score - differential abundance

Differential abundance analysis with Aldex2 performed on all possible pairwise comparisons of clinical score groups.

### 0 - 1

```{r}
#| label: aldex2-score0-1
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true
#| results: 'hide'

###################################################
# DIFFERENTIAL ABUNDANCE ANALYSIS CLINICAL SCORES #
###################################################

#aldex metadata 
aldexmeta <- clinical_score %>%
  filter(`Clinical score (0-5)` %in% c("0", "1"))

aldexmeta <- aldexmeta %>%
filter(group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"))

#aldex data 
aldexdata <- estimated_counts

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  filter(svamp_ID %in% aldexmeta$svamp_ID) %>%
  mutate(svamp_ID = factor(svamp_ID, levels = aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) %>%
  arrange(svamp_ID)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "svamp_ID")

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
    dplyr::select(-c("barcode_shotgun_swab", "after_kraken2_host_removal"))

aldexdata <- t(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- as.data.frame(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% mutate_all(as.numeric)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
  filter(!if_all(everything(), ~ . == 0))

#check if they match names
setdiff(colnames(aldexdata), aldexmeta$svamp_ID) #no differences

setdiff(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, colnames(aldexdata)) #S10

aldexmeta <- aldexmeta %>%
  filter(!svamp_ID %in% c("S10"))

all.equal(names(aldexdata),c(aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) #TRUE


#Get the indices of the names in the same order
order_indices <- match(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, names(aldexdata))

#Reorder the columns to match the order 
aldexdata <- aldexdata[, order_indices]

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
mutate_at(c(1:49), as.integer)

#set the conditions to compare 
conds <-factor(aldexmeta$`Clinical score (0-5)`, levels=c("0", "1")) 

#vector needs to be character 
conds <- as.character(conds)

#aldex
x_all_0_1_clinical_score <- ALDEx2::aldex(aldexdata, conds, mc.samples=128, test="t", effect=TRUE,
     include.sample.summary=FALSE, denom="all", verbose=FALSE)

x_all_0_1_clinical_score <- x_all_0_1_clinical_score %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "species")

write_csv(x_all_0_1_clinical_score, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score/dif_abundance_clinical_score_01.csv")

```

### Differential abundance table significant differences (before FDR)

After performing all the differential abundance analyses, the taxa that show up significant before adjusting of the p-value are combined into one table. This comprises all the performed 1 by 1 comparisons of clinical scores.

```{r}
#| label: differential-abundance-significant
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#list of dfs from the differential abundance analyses
df_names <- ls(pattern = "^x_all.*_score$")

#combine significant results from all differential abundance analyses
combined_significant_clinical_score_aldex2 <- df_names %>%
  lapply(function(nm) {
    df <- get(nm)                
    df %>%
      filter(we.ep < 0.05) %>%  
      mutate(source_df = nm)      
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()                      

combined_significant_clinical_score_aldex2 %>%
gt()

write_csv(combined_significant_clinical_score_aldex2, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score/combined_significant_clinical_score_aldex2.csv")
```

### Differential abundance table significant differences (after FDR)

After performing all the differential abundance analyses, the taxa that show up significant after adjusting of the p-value are combined into one table. This comprises all the performed 1 by 1 comparisons of clinical scores.

```{r}
#| label: differential-abundance-significant-afterFDR-CS
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#list of dfs from the differential abundance analyses
df_names <- ls(pattern = "^x_all.*_score$")

#combine significant results from all differential abundance analyses
combined_significant_clinical_score_aldex2_afterFDR <- df_names %>%
  lapply(function(nm) {
    df <- get(nm)                
    df %>%
      filter(we.eBH < 0.05) %>%  
      mutate(source_df = nm)      
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()                      

combined_significant_clinical_score_aldex2_afterFDR %>%
gt()

write_csv(combined_significant_clinical_score_aldex2_afterFDR, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score/combined_significant_clinical_score_aldex2_afterFDR.csv")
```

## Volcano plots clinical score differential abundance (before FDR)

For each one by one comparison of clinical score microbiomes, volcano plots are made that show the species considered significantly different between the two clinical scores compared. The p-value before FDR is employed for the figure and -log10 transformed for visualization purposes. The difference between species relative abundance (fold change) is log2 transformed for the same reason.

```{r}
#| label: volcano-clinical-score
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

# define cutoffs
fc_cutoff <- 1
p_cutoff <- 0.05

# find all dfs starting with x_all and ending with _score
df_names <- ls(pattern = "^x_all.*_score$")

# create empty list to store plots
volcano_plots <- list()

# loop over each df name
for (nm in df_names) {

  df <- get(nm)

  # get species info
  species_levels <- unique(df$species)
  species_count <- length(species_levels)

  color_palette_volcano <- setNames(
    colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(species_count),
    species_levels
  )

  # define significance based on fold change and p-value
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        diff.btw > fc_cutoff & we.ep < p_cutoff ~ "Up",
        diff.btw < -fc_cutoff & we.ep < p_cutoff ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "Non-significant"
      )
    )

  # prepare significant species labels
  sig_species <- df %>%
    filter(significance != "Non-significant") %>%
    mutate(
      pretty_label = paste0(
        "italic('",
        gsub("_", " ", sub("^s__", "", species)),
        "')"
      )
    )

  # define volcano plot colors
  volcano_colors <- c(
    "Up" = "hotpink",
    "Down" = "#2166ac",
    "Non-significant" = "gray70"
  )

  # create volcano plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = diff.btw, y = -log10(we.ep), color = significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = volcano_colors) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = sig_species,
      aes(label = pretty_label),
      parse = TRUE,
      size = 5,
      box.padding = 0.5,
      point.padding = 0.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      title = paste0("Volcano Plot: ", nm)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

  # store in list
  volcano_plots[[nm]] <- p
  
}

# view all plots in the list
volcano_plots

ggsave(plot = volcano_plots[["x_all_0_1_clinical_score"]], "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score/251121_VMBcandida_luminal_cross_sectional_clinical_score_01_volcano_plots.png", width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```

## Volcano plots clinical score differential abundance (after FDR)

After adjusting for multiple comparison, the species that remain to be significantly different is Limosilactobacillus portuensis. To visualize this, volcano plots were also made for these comparisons of clincal scores.

#### 0 VS 4

```{r}
#| label: volcano-plot-0-4
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

species_levels <- unique(x_all_0_4_clinical_score$species)
species_count <- length(species_levels)

color_palette_volcano <- setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(species_count), species_levels)

significant_species_difabu <- x_all_0_4_clinical_score %>%
  filter(abs(diff.btw) > 1 & we.eBH < 0.05)

significant_species <- significant_species_difabu$species 

significant_species_clean <- str_replace_all(significant_species, "^s__|_", " ")

#define cutoffs
fc_cutoff <- 1
p_cutoff <- 0.05

#is the species significant or not 
x_all_0_4_clinical_score <- x_all_0_4_clinical_score %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      diff.btw > fc_cutoff & we.eBH < p_cutoff ~ "Up",
      diff.btw < -fc_cutoff & we.eBH < p_cutoff ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "Non-significant")
  )

#colors
volcano_colors <- c(
  "Up" = "hotpink",          #pink
  "Down" = "#2166ac",        # blue
  "Non-significant" = "gray70"
)

#volcano plot with cutoffs (significance and fold change)
volcano_difa_cutoffs_0_4 <- ggplot(x_all_0_4_clinical_score,
                       aes(x = diff.btw, y = -log10(we.eBH), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = volcano_colors) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = x_all_0_4_clinical_score %>% filter(significance != "Non-significant"),
    aes(label = significant_species_clean),
    size = 5,
    color = "black",
    max.overlaps = 20
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
    title = "Volcano Plot: 0 vs 4"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

plot(volcano_difa_cutoffs_0_4)

ggsave("~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score/251121_VMBcandida_luminal_cross_sectional_volcano_0_4_afterFDR.png", plot = volcano_difa_cutoffs_0_4, bg = "white", width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

## Barplot per clinical score

```{r}
#| label: barplot-cs
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

###########################
# CLINICAL SCORE BARPLOTS #
###########################

#to long format
rel_abund_cross_cs_long <- merged_clinical_score %>%
pivot_longer(
     cols = starts_with("s__"),
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "Abundance"
)

#only the top 15 species are maitained and the rest is summed to a other category 
accepted_species_cross <- c("s__Lactobacillus_crispatus", "s__Lactobacillus_iners", "s__Gardnerella_vaginalis", "s__Lactobacillus_jensenii", "s__Lactobacillus_gasseri", "s__Fannyhessea_vaginae", "s__Aerococcus_christensenii", "s__Megasphaera_lornae", "s__Limosilactobacillus_portuensis","s__Staphylococcus_aureus","s__Prevotella_bivia", "s__Streptococcus_agalactiae", "s__Candida_albicans", "s__Ureaplasma_parvum", "s__Dialister_micraerophilus")                         

rel_abund_cross_cs_long <- rel_abund_cross_cs_long %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species %in% accepted_species_cross, Species, "other"))


df_rel_cs_all <- rel_abund_cross_cs_long %>%
  group_by(`Clinical score (0-5)`, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(`Clinical score (0-5)`) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_abundance = total_abundance / sum(total_abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


barplot_clinical_score_all <- ggplot(
  df_rel_cs_all,
  aes(x = factor(`Clinical score (0-5)`), y = rel_abundance, fill = Species)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "Clinical score (0–5)",
    y = "Relative abundance (%)",
    fill = "Species",
    title = "Species composition by clinical score all samples"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = group.colors,
    labels = function(x) {
      gsub("_", " ", sub("s__", "", x))
    }
  )

plot(barplot_clinical_score_all)

ggsave("~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score/251121_VMBcandida_luminal_cross_sectional_barplot_per_clinical_score.png", plot = barplot_clinical_score_all, bg = "white", width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: candida-cs
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

###########################
# CANDIDA CLINICAL SCORES # 
###########################


merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_cs <- merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional %>%
left_join(clinical_score_cross)

mpa4_samplerows_groups_long_cross <- merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_cs %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("s__"),
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )

mpa4_samplerows_groups_candida_cross <- mpa4_samplerows_groups_long_cross %>%
  filter(Species == "s__Candida_albicans")

candida_violin_cross <- ggplot(mpa4_samplerows_groups_candida_cross, aes(x = factor(`Clinical score (0-5)`, levels = 0:5), y = Abundance, group = `Clinical score (0-5)`)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", fill = NA) +
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.2, size = 3) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = "mean", 
    geom = "crossbar", 
    width = 0.8, 
    color = "#B2007F", 
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme (axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
         axis.title.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 20, angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 20)), 
         plot.title = element_blank(), 
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
         axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5)) +
  ggtitle("Candida Abundance by Clinical score (Violin Plot with Mean)") +
  labs(
    x = "Clinical score",
    y = bquote(italic("C. albicans") ~ "abundance (%)")) #+ 
  #stat_compare_means(label="p.signif",exact = FALSE, comparisons = list(c("RVVCpos","RVVCneg"),c("RVVCpos","Control"),c("RVVCneg","AS"), c("AS","Control")), size = 6, bracket.size = 0.5, tip.length = 0.01)

plot(candida_violin_cross)

ggsave("~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score/251121_VMBcandida_luminal_cross_sectional_candida_violin.png", plot = candida_violin_cross, bg = "white", width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)

  mpa4_samplerows_groups_candida_cross$`Clinical score (0-5)`,

)

median_candida_groups_cross_cs <- mpa4_samplerows_groups_candida_cross %>%

    Min_Abundance = min(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE))



#subset in clinical scores
```

```{r}
mpa4_samplerows_groups_gvag_cross <- mpa4_samplerows_groups_long_cross %>%
  filter(Species == "s__Gardnerella_vaginalis")

gvag_violin_cross <- ggplot(mpa4_samplerows_groups_gvag_cross, aes(x = factor(`Clinical score (0-5)`, levels = 0:5), y = Abundance, group = `Clinical score (0-5)`)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", fill = NA) +
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.2, size = 3) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = "mean", 
    geom = "crossbar", 
    width = 0.8, 
    color = "#B2007F", 
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme (axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
         axis.title.y = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 20, angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 20)), 
         plot.title = element_blank(), 
         axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
         axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 20, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5)) +
  ggtitle("G. vaginalis Abundance by Clinical score (Violin Plot with Mean)") +
  labs(
    x = "Clinical score",
    y = bquote(italic("G. vaginalis") ~ "Abundance (%)")) #+ 
  #stat_compare_means(label="p.signif",exact = FALSE, comparisons = list(c("0","1"),c("RVVCpos","Control"),c("RVVCneg","AS"), c("AS","Control")), size = 6, bracket.size = 0.5, tip.length = 0.01)

kruskal.test(Abundance ~ `Clinical score (0-5)`, data = mpa4_samplerows_groups_gvag_cross)

pairwise.wilcox.test(

  mpa4_samplerows_groups_gvag_cross$`Clinical score (0-5)`,
  p.adjust.method = "BH"
)

kruskal.test(Abundance ~ as.numeric(`Clinical score (0-5)`), 
             data = mpa4_samplerows_groups_gvag_cross)

pairwise.wilcox.test(
  mpa4_samplerows_groups_gvag_cross$Abundance,
  mpa4_samplerows_groups_gvag_cross$`Clinical score (0-5)`, 
    p.adjust.method = "none"
)
```

# Clinical and medical history data

From the collection patient clinical and medical data a table 1 was created across all cross-sectional groups.

## Table 1

```{r}
#| label: table1
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

###########
# TABLE 1 #
###########

#using the clinical data from questionaires and examinations 

#select the columns ofr interest
table1_columns <- clinical_data %>%
dplyr::select(c("svamp_ID", "group_cross", "Symptom score (0-5) - ibland har de svarat olika skriftligt i frågeformuläret och muntligt vid inklusiion, då har jag valt den högsta scoren", "Clinical score (0-5)", "Clinical score: redness (y/n)", "Clinical score: discharge (y/n)", "Clinical score: dryness (y/n)", "Clinical score: fissures (y/n)", "Clinical score: hyphae (y/n)", "Wet smear: hyphae (y/n)", "Wet smear: amount of lactobacilli (normal/decreased)", "Age (years)", "Height (cm)", "Weight (kg)", "Smoker (y/n)", "Stable relationship (y/n)", "Healthy (y/n)", "Medicatons (y/n)", "Medications (which?)", "Cortisone drugs (y/n)", "Regular menstruation (y/n)", "Pregnancies (#)", "Children (#)", "Current contraceptive (which?)", "Chlamydia (y/n)", "Herpes (y/n)", "Condyloma (y/n)", "Foul-smelling vaginal discharge (y/n)", "Debut of fungal infections (when?)", "How often can you have intercourse without gynecological problems? (several times a week, y/n)", "How often can you have intercourse without gynecological problems? (a couple times a month, y/n)", "How often can you have intercourse without gynecological problems? (less often, y/n)", "How often can you have intercourse without gynecological problems? (never, y/n)"))

#create new columns from present info
#BMI
table1_columns <- table1_columns %>%
mutate(
    `Weight (kg)` = as.numeric(`Weight (kg)`),
    `Height (cm)` = as.numeric(`Height (cm)`),
    BMI = `Weight (kg)` / ((`Height (cm)` / 100) ^ 2)
)

#medication use, specify which types of medication (create new columns that are factors for the specific categories of medications used)
table1_columns <- table1_columns %>%
  mutate(
    antidepressants = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Medications (which?)`, ""), regex("citalopram|esticipalopran|livotril|sertralin|escitalopram|voxtra|sertrone|sertralun", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ),
    allergy = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Medications (which?)`, ""), regex("xolair|vantoline|turbohaler|cetrizin|desloratadin|antihistamin|atarax|loratadin|dymista|asthma", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ),
    ADHD = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Medications (which?)`, ""), regex("concerta|metylphenidate", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ),
    acne = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Medications (which?)`, ""), regex("isotreonin|dienorette", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ),
    gastric_reflux = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Medications (which?)`, ""), regex("omeprazol", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ),
    high_blood_pressure = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Medications (which?)`, ""), regex("metoprolol", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ),
    insomnia = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Medications (which?)`, ""), regex("propavan", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ),
    endometriosis = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Medications (which?)`, ""), regex("endovelle", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ) 
  )

#contraceptive use, seperate into different factor columns per type 
table1_columns <- table1_columns %>%
  mutate(
    hormonal_IUD = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Current contraceptive (which?)`, ""), regex("IUD mirena|IUD hormonal|IUD jaydess|IUD hyleena", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ),
    copper_IUD = if_else(
        str_detect(coalesce(`Current contraceptive (which?)`, ""), regex("IUD copper", ignore_case = TRUE)),
      1, 0
    ), 
    birth_control_pills = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Current contraceptive (which?)`, ""), regex("pills", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ), 
    condom = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Current contraceptive (which?)`, ""), regex("condom", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ), 
    no_contraceptive = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Current contraceptive (which?)`, ""), regex("none", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    ), 
    hormonal_implant = if_else(
      str_detect(coalesce(`Current contraceptive (which?)`, ""), regex("implant", ignore_case = TRUE)), 
      1, 0
    )
   )

#fungal debut, reformulate the data so it can be seen as a numeric value (extract numeric value and drop the "years ago" + for the values that were written as months overwrite with the value it should be in years)
table1_columns <- table1_columns %>%
  mutate(
    infection_duration_num = str_extract(`Debut of fungal infections (when?)`, "\\d+")
  )

table1_columns$infection_duration_num[c(6)] <- NA
table1_columns$infection_duration_num[c(30, 33, 77)] <- 0.5

#select the samples of interest 
table1_cross <- table1_columns %>%
 filter(group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"))

#remove S10 and S15 since these were filtered out 
table1_cross <- table1_cross %>%
  filter(!svamp_ID %in% c("S10", "S15"))

#remove the columns that don't need to be included in table1 (heigth, weight, medications (which), current contraceptive (which), debut of fungal infection)
table1_cross <- table1_cross %>%
dplyr::select(-c("Height (cm)", "Weight (kg)", "Medications (which?)", "Current contraceptive (which?)", "Debut of fungal infections (when?)"))

#missing and saknas written as na 
table1_cross[] <- lapply(table1_cross, as.character)
table1_cross[table1_cross == "missing" | table1_cross == "saknas" | table1_cross == "Missing"] <- NA

#make the NA cells to actual text na 
table1_cross <- table1_cross %>%
  mutate(across(
    everything(),
    ~ {
      x <- as.character(.)                                
      x[is.na(x) | str_trim(x) == ""] <- "NA"             
      x
    }
  ))

#specify which variables need to be numeric and which need to be a factor  
cols_to_convert <- c("Clinical score (0-5)", "Symptom score (0-5) - ibland har de svarat olika skriftligt i frågeformuläret och muntligt vid inklusiion, då har jag valt den högsta scoren", "Age (years)", "BMI", "infection_duration_num", "Pregnancies (#)", "Children (#)")

table1_cross <- table1_cross %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_to_convert), as.numeric),
         across(-all_of(cols_to_convert), as.factor)
         )

#define the function
library(table1)

pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  y <- unlist(x)
  g <- factor(rep(names(x), times = sapply(x, length)))
  
  if (is.numeric(y)) {
    num_groups <- length(unique(g))
    
    #two groups → Wilcoxon, more than two → Kruskal–Wallis
    if (num_groups == 2) {
      p <- wilcox.test(y ~ g)$p.value
    } else {
      p <- kruskal.test(y ~ g)$p.value
    }
    
  } else {
    #always perform Fisher's exact test for categorical variables
    tbl <- table(y, g)
    p <- fisher.test(tbl)$p.value
  }
  
  c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))
}

#p-value function
pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  y <- unlist(x)
  g <- factor(rep(names(x), times = sapply(x, length)))

  keep <- !is.na(y) & !is.na(g)
  y <- y[keep]
  g <- droplevels(g[keep])

  if (length(unique(g)) < 2 || length(unique(y)) < 2) {
    return(c("", ""))
  }

  if (is.numeric(y)) {
    p <- if (length(unique(g)) == 2) {
      wilcox.test(y ~ g, exact = FALSE)$p.value
    } else {
      kruskal.test(y ~ g)$p.value
    }
  } else {
    y <- droplevels(factor(y))
    tbl <- table(y, g)
    tbl <- tbl[rowSums(tbl) > 0, colSums(tbl) > 0, drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(tbl) < 2 || ncol(tbl) < 2) {
      return(c("", ""))
    }

    p <- stats::fisher.test(tbl)$p.value
  }

  c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)))
}
```

## Network graphs

The correlation between species is calculated and visualized within a network graph.

```{r}
#| label: network-graph-species
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

##############################
# NETWORK CORRELATION GRAPHS #
##############################

library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(WGCNA)


#df with only the species -> mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized
species_mat <- mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized

cor_mat <- cor(species_mat, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cor_p <- corPvalueStudent(cor_mat, nrow(species_mat))


#TOP 15 species 
#parameters ---
threshold <- 0.3     
p_threshold <- 0.05 

#the list of species you want labeled
top15_species <- c(
  "s__Lactobacillus_crispatus",
  "s__Lactobacillus_iners",
  "s__Lactobacillus_gasseri",
  "s__Lactobacillus_jensenii",
  "s__Gardnerella_vaginalis",
  "s__Fannyhessea_vaginae",
  "s__Streptococcus_agalactiae",
  "s__Limosilactobacillus_portuensis",
  "s__Staphylococcus_aureus",
  "s__Prevotella_bivia",
  "other",
  "s__Dialister_micraerophilus",
  "s__Ureaplasma_parvum",
  "s__Aerococcus_christensenii",
  "s__Candida_albicans",
  "s__Megasphaera_lornae"
)

#filter significant correlations
sig_mat <- cor_mat
sig_mat[abs(cor_mat) < threshold | cor_p > p_threshold] <- 0
diag(sig_mat) <- 0

#create graph
g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(sig_mat, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)

#remove isolated nodes
g <- delete_vertices(g, degree(g) == 0)

#vertex attributes
V(g)$abundance <- colMeans(species_mat)[V(g)$name]

#clustering (Louvain)
cluster_weights <- E(g)$weight
cluster_weights[cluster_weights < 0] <- 0
cl <- cluster_louvain(g, weights = cluster_weights)
V(g)$cluster <- cl$membership

#cluster colors
num_clusters <- max(cl$membership)
cluster_colors <- brewer.pal(min(num_clusters, 12), "Set3")
V(g)$color <- cluster_colors[V(g)$cluster]

#edge aesthetics
E(g)$sign <- ifelse(E(g)$weight > 0, "positive", "negative")
E(g)$alpha <- abs(E(g)$weight)

#layout (FR with positive weights)
g_layout <- g
E(g_layout)$weight <- abs(E(g_layout)$weight)
set.seed(123)
layout <- create_layout(g_layout, layout = "fr")

#label ONLY if node name is in top15_species
layout$label <- ifelse(V(g)$name %in% top15_species, V(g)$name, "")

#plot
network_cross_all <- ggraph(layout) +
  geom_edge_link(aes(color = sign, alpha = alpha, width = alpha),
                 show.legend = TRUE, lineend = "round") +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("positive" = "#1B9E77",
                                     "negative" = "#D95F02")) +
  scale_edge_alpha(range = c(0.2, 0.9)) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.4, 2)) +
  geom_node_point(aes(size = abundance, fill = factor(cluster)),
                  shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.4) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 12)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = label),
                 repel = TRUE,
                 size = 3,
                 point.padding = 0.2,
                 max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  ) +
  guides(
    size       = guide_legend("Mean abundance"),
    fill       = guide_legend("Cluster"),
    edge_color = guide_legend("Correlation sign"),
    edge_width = "none",
    edge_alpha = "none"
  )

plot(network_cross_all)  

ggsave(plot = network_cross_all,  "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/networks/251218_network_cross_all.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cluster_colors_AS <- brewer.pal(min(num_clusters_AS, 12), "Set3")
V(g_AS)$color <- cluster_colors_AS[V(g_AS)$cluster]

num_clusters_Control <- max(cl_Control$membership)
cluster_colors_Control <- brewer.pal(min(num_clusters_Control, 12), "Set3")
V(g_Control)$color <- cluster_colors_Control[V(g_Control)$cluster]                                                     

#edge aesthetics 
E(g_RVVCpos)$sign <- ifelse(E(g_RVVCpos)$weight > 0, "positive", "negative")
E(g_RVVCpos)$alpha <- abs(E(g_RVVCpos)$weight)

E(g_RVVCneg)$sign <- ifelse(E(g_RVVCneg)$weight > 0, "positive", "negative")
E(g_RVVCneg)$alpha <- abs(E(g_RVVCneg)$weight)

E(g_AS)$sign <- ifelse(E(g_AS)$weight > 0, "positive", "negative")
E(g_AS)$alpha <- abs(E(g_AS)$weight)

E(g_Control)$sign <- ifelse(E(g_Control)$weight > 0, "positive", "negative")
E(g_Control)$alpha <- abs(E(g_Control)$weight)                                                     
  
#layout (FR with positive weights) 
g_layout_RVVCpos <- g_RVVCpos
E(g_layout_RVVCpos)$weight <- abs(E(g_layout_RVVCpos)$weight)
set.seed(123)
layout_RVVCpos <- create_layout(g_layout_RVVCpos, layout = "fr")

g_layout_RVVCneg <- g_RVVCneg
E(g_layout_RVVCneg)$weight <- abs(E(g_layout_RVVCneg)$weight)
set.seed(123)
layout_RVVCneg <- create_layout(g_layout_RVVCneg, layout = "fr")

g_layout_AS <- g_AS
E(g_layout_AS)$weight <- abs(E(g_layout_AS)$weight)
set.seed(123)
layout_AS <- create_layout(g_layout_AS, layout = "fr")

g_layout_Control <- g_Control
E(g_layout_Control)$weight <- abs(E(g_layout_Control)$weight)
set.seed(123)
layout_Control <- create_layout(g_layout_Control, layout = "fr")                                                     

#label ONLY if node name is in top15_species 
layout_RVVCpos$label <- ifelse(V(g_RVVCpos)$name %in% top15_species, V(g_RVVCpos)$name, "")

layout_RVVCneg$label <- ifelse(V(g_RVVCneg)$name %in% top15_species, V(g_RVVCneg)$name, "")

layout_AS$label <- ifelse(V(g_AS)$name %in% top15_species, V(g_AS)$name, "")

layout_Control$label <- ifelse(V(g_Control)$name %in% top15_species, V(g_Control)$name, "")                                                     

#plot
network_cross_RVVCpos <- ggraph(layout_RVVCpos) +
  geom_edge_link(aes(color = sign, alpha = alpha, width = alpha),
                 show.legend = TRUE, lineend = "round") +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("positive" = "#1B9E77",
```

## Testing the amount of Lactobacilli species + other interesting species between groups

Lactobacilli species and other interesting species are tested between cross-sectional groups

```{r}
#| label: lactobacilli-species
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#######################
# INTERESTING SPECIES #
#######################

lacto_vars <- c("s__Lactobacillus_iners", "s__Lactobacillus_crispatus", "s__Lactobacillus_jensenii", "s__Lactobacillus_gasseri", "s__Limosilactobacillus_portuensis", "s__Candida_albicans", "s__Gardnerella_vaginalis")

df_lacto <- merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional %>%
  dplyr::select(group_cross, all_of(lacto_vars))

df_lacto_long <- df_lacto %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = lacto_vars,
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )

library(stringr)

species_labels <- function(strings) {
  sapply(strings, function(string) {
    sp <- gsub("^s__", "", string)
    parts <- strsplit(sp, "_")[[1]]
    genus <- parts[1]
    species <- parts[2]
    genus_abbrev <- paste0(substr(genus, 1, 1), ".")
    formatted <- paste(genus_abbrev, species)
    as.expression(bquote(.(formatted)))
  })
}

lacto_species_violin <- ggplot(df_lacto_long, aes(x = group_cross, y = Abundance)) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.2,
    fill = "grey70",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0),
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 1.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = "mean",
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.4,
    color = "#B2007F",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
 stat_compare_means(
    label = "p.signif",
    comparisons = list(
      c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg"),
      c("RVVCpos", "Control"), 
      c("RVVCpos", "AS"), 
      c("RVVCneg", "AS"),
      c("RVVCneg", "Control"),
      c("AS", "Control")
    ),
    size = 6,
    bracket.size = 0,
    tip.length = 0,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Species,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = labeller(Species = species_labels)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "italic"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Abundance (%)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

plot(lacto_species_violin)

ggsave(plot = lacto_species_violin,  "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/major bacteria/251218_species_violin.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

library(rstatix)

kruskal_lacto <- df_lacto_long %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  kruskal_test(Abundance ~ group_cross) 

kruskal_lacto %>%
gt()

write_csv(kruskal_lacto, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/major bacteria/251218_species_kruskal_wallis.csv")

dunn_results <- df_lacto_long %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%   
  dunn_test(
    Abundance ~ group_cross,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"  
  )

dunn_results %>%
gt()

write_csv(dunn_results, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/major bacteria/251218_species_dunn.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: barplot-per-group

###########
# BARPLOT #

df_rel <- ra_samplerows_long_other_cross %>%
  group_by(group_cross, Species) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(group_cross) %>%
  mutate(rel_abundance = total_abundance / sum(total_abundance)) %>%
  ungroup()

ra_cross_all <- ggplot(df_rel, aes(x = group_cross, y = rel_abundance, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "Group (group_cross)",
    y = "Relative abundance (%)",
    fill = "Species",
    title = "Species composition by group_cross"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_discrete(
  limits = c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg", "AS", "Control"),
  labels = c(
    expression(RVVC^"cul.pos"),
    expression(RVVC^"cul.neg"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.pos"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.neg")
  )
) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 20), 
      panel.border = element_blank(), 
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = group.colors,
  labels = function(x) {
    gsub("_", " ", sub("s__", "", x))
  }
) 

plot(ra_cross_all)

ggsave(plot = ra_cross_all, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/relative abundance/251218_barplot_cross_groups.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Correlations with clinical features in cross sectional groups

Correlation between species and clinical features that make up the clinical score

```{r}
#| label: correlation-cs-ra
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

###########################################
# CORRELATION CLINICAL FEATURES - SPECIES #
###########################################

cross_cs_ra <- clinical_score %>%
left_join(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional, by = "svamp_ID")

#all groups 
clinical_vars <- grep("\\(y/n\\)", names(cross_cs_ra), value = TRUE)

microbiome_vars <- grep("^s__", names(cross_cs_ra), value = TRUE)

cross_cs_ra_long <- cross_cs_ra %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(microbiome_vars),
               names_to = "species",
               values_to = "abundance")

cor_results <- cross_cs_ra_long %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(clinical_vars),
               names_to = "clinical",
               values_to = "clinical_value") %>%
  group_by(clinical, species) %>%
  summarise(
    result = list(cor.test(clinical_value, abundance, method = "pearson") %>% tidy()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(result)

cor_results <- cor_results %>%
  mutate(p.adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))

write_csv(cor_results, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score/251105_VMBcandida_luminal_correlation_species-clinical-features.csv")

sig <- cor_results %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) 

cor_results_filtered<- cor_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) %>%
  mutate(significant = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, TRUE, FALSE))


heatmap_mat <- cor_results_filtered %>%
  select(species, clinical, estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clinical, values_from = estimate, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mat <- cor_results_filtered %>%
  select(species, clinical, p.value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clinical, values_from = p.value, values_fill = 1) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mat <- sig_mat < 0.05

pretty_taxa_names <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("s__", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x)   
  x
}

rownames(heatmap_mat) <- pretty_taxa_names(rownames(heatmap_mat))

Heatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  name = "Correlation",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,  
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if(sig_mat[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height, 
                gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2, fill = NA))
    }
  },
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "italic"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Correlation")
)

)

dev.off()

plot(heatmap_RVVCneg)  

#AS
cross_cs_ra_AS <- cross_cs_ra %>%
filter(group_cross.x == "AS")

clinical_vars_AS <- grep("\\(y/n\\)", names(cross_cs_ra_AS), value = TRUE)

microbiome_vars_AS <- grep("^s__", names(cross_cs_ra_AS), value = TRUE)

cross_cs_ra_long_AS <- cross_cs_ra_AS %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(microbiome_vars_AS),
               names_to = "species",
               values_to = "abundance")

cor_results_AS <- cross_cs_ra_long_AS %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(clinical_vars_AS),
               names_to = "clinical",
               values_to = "clinical_value") %>%
  group_by(clinical, species) %>%
  summarise(
    result = list(cor.test(clinical_value, abundance, method = "pearson") %>% tidy()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(result)

cor_results_AS <- cor_results_AS %>%
  mutate(p.adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))

sig_AS <- cor_results_AS %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) 


cor_results_AS_filtered <- cor_results_AS %>%
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) %>%
  mutate(significant = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, TRUE, FALSE))


heatmap_mat_AS <- cor_results_AS_filtered %>%
  select(species, clinical, estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clinical, values_from = estimate, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mat_AS <- cor_results_AS_filtered %>%
  select(species, clinical, p.value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clinical, values_from = p.value, values_fill = 1) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mat_AS <- sig_mat_AS < 0.05

pretty_taxa_names <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("s__", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x)   
  x
}

rownames(heatmap_mat_AS) <- pretty_taxa_names(rownames(heatmap_mat_AS))

png(
  filename = "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/heatmap/correlation_clinical_species_AS.png",
  width = 2000,
  height = 2000,
  res = 300
)

heatmap_AS <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_mat_AS,
  name = "Correlation",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,  
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if(sig_mat_RVVCpos[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(x = x, y = y, width = width, height = height, 
                gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2, fill = NA))
    }
  },
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "italic"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Correlation")
)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
df_rvvcneg   <- df_filtered_cross %>% filter(group_cross == "RVVCneg")

#prepare heatmap matrices
heatmap_matrix_rvvcpos <- df_rvvcpos %>%
  select(svamp_ID, all_of(features)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("svamp_ID") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  apply(2, as.numeric)

heatmap_matrix_rvvcneg <- df_rvvcneg %>%

  column_to_rownames("svamp_ID") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  apply(2, as.numeric)

heatmap_matrix_as <- df_as %>%
  select(svamp_ID, all_of(features)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("svamp_ID") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  apply(2, as.numeric)

heatmap_matrix_control <- df_control %>%

#define color mapping
col_fun <- c("0" = "white", "1" = "#B2007F")  

#generate heatmaps

  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey90")
)

)

ht_control <- Heatmap(
```

# Comparison RVVCpos seperate VS Diverse cluster

Based on the generated bulk transcriptomic data a UMAP across cross-sectional groups was made. Here two seperate clusters were observed, Diverse and Seperate. Comparison RVVCpos seperate cluster against RVVCpos samples that are in the diverse group is performed here. Where applicable CLR transformation was performed on the data before performing any statistical or correlation testing.

## Add clustering info file

Per svamp_ID the information is added whether this was a sample clustering separately in the bulk transcriptomics UMAP (RVVCpos_seperate) or clustering together with all the other cross sectional groups (RVVCpos_diverse).

```{r}
#| label: clusters
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

################
# CLUSTER INFO #
################

clustering_groups <- read_xlsx("~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/data/Clustering_groups.xlsx")

```

## Select data for clustering RVVCpos samples

Create a df with only the RVVCpos samples data, plus a df that contains their metadata including the clustering group

```{r}
#| label: data-selection
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#############################
# SAMPLE SELECTION CLUSTERS #
#############################

samplerows_clustering_merged <- merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional %>%
filter(svamp_ID %in% clustering_groups$svamp_ID)

samplerows_clustering_merged <- samplerows_clustering_merged %>% left_join(clustering_groups %>% dplyr::select(svamp_ID, Cluster), by = "svamp_ID")

samplerows_clustering <- samplerows_clustering_merged[, -(1:16)]

rownames(samplerows_clustering) <- samplerows_clustering_merged$svamp_ID
```

## Renormalize data

Per sample, the total relative abundance is renormalized to sum up to 100%.

```{r}
#| label: renormalize-RVVCpos
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

###############
# RENORMALIZE #
###############

samplerows_clustering_renormalized <- samplerows_clustering %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(SUM = sum(c_across(1:54), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(across(1:54, ~ (. / SUM) * 100)) %>%
  mutate(SUM_CHECK = sum(c_across(1:54), na.rm = TRUE)) 
 

samplerows_clustering_renormalized <- samplerows_clustering_renormalized %>% 
  dplyr::select(-SUM, -SUM_CHECK)

rownames(samplerows_clustering_renormalized) <- samplerows_clustering_merged$svamp_ID

samplerows_clustering_merged_renormalized <- samplerows_clustering_merged

common_cols <- intersect(names(samplerows_clustering_merged_renormalized), names(samplerows_clustering_renormalized))

samplerows_clustering_merged_renormalized[common_cols] <- samplerows_clustering_renormalized[common_cols]


```

## Alpha diversity

Shannon, Inverse Simpson and Species number

```{r}
#| label: alpha-RVVCpos
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

############################
# ALPHA DIVERSITY CLUSTERS #
############################

samplerows_clustering_renormalized <- as.data.frame(samplerows_clustering_renormalized)

samplerows_clustering_renormalized <- samplerows_clustering_renormalized %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

rownames(samplerows_clustering_renormalized) <- samplerows_clustering_merged$svamp_ID

shann_rvvc_df <- vegan::diversity(samplerows_clustering_renormalized,index = c("shannon") )
simp_rvvc_df <- vegan::diversity(samplerows_clustering_renormalized,index  = c("simpson") )
invsimp_rvvc_df <- vegan::diversity(samplerows_clustering_renormalized,index  = c("invsimpson") )
spec_rvvc_df <-as.numeric(vegan::specnumber(samplerows_clustering_renormalized))
divers_rvvc <- as.matrix(rbind(shann_rvvc_df,simp_rvvc_df,invsimp_rvvc_df,spec_rvvc_df) )
divers_rvvc[is.infinite(divers_rvvc)] <- 0
rownames(divers_rvvc) <- c("Shannon","simpson","Inv Simpson","SpecNo")

divers_t_rvvc <-as.data.frame(t(divers_rvvc))%>%
  mutate(svamp_ID=colnames(divers_rvvc))

metadata_divers_rvvc <- clustering_groups %>%
  left_join(divers_t_rvvc, by = "svamp_ID")

metadata_divers_rvvc <- metadata_divers_rvvc %>%
filter(!svamp_ID %in% c("S15", "S44"))

metadata_divers_rvvc <- metadata_divers_rvvc %>%
  mutate(Cluster = factor(Cluster, 
                                  levels = c("RVVCpos_seperate", "RVVCpos_diverse")))

write_csv(metadata_divers_rvvc, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/alpha_diversity.csv")


shann2_rvvc <- ggplot(metadata_divers_rvvc, aes (x=Cluster,y=Shannon,group=Cluster)) +
  geom_violin() +
  #geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(height = .2, width = .05)) +
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.2, size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", width = 0.8,colour = "#B2007F", linewidth = 1.5)+theme_classic()+ggtitle("Shannon") +
  #stat_compare_means(label="p.signif",comparisons = list(c("RVVCpos_seperate","RVVCpos_diverse")), hide.ns = FALSE, size = 10, bracket.size = 2 ) +
  labs(y = "Shannon", title = NULL) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
         axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 20)), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, angle = 45, vjust = 0.5), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20)) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "RVVCpos_diverse"  = "Diverse",
      "RVVCpos_seperate" = "Separate"
    )
  )


plot(shann2_rvvc)

ggsave(plot = shann2_rvvc, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/shannon_diversity.png", bg = "white")


simp2_rvvc <- ggplot(metadata_divers_rvvc, aes(x = Cluster, y = `Inv Simpson`, group = Cluster)) +
  geom_violin() +
```

## Differential abundance analysis

Aldex2 differential abundance analysis between clusters

```{r}
#| label: aldex2-RVVCpos
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true
#| results: 'hide'

###################################
# DIFFERENTIAL ABUNDANCE CLUSTERS #
###################################

#aldex metadata 
aldexmeta <- clustering_groups %>%
  filter(`Cluster` %in% c("RVVCpos_seperate", "RVVCpos_diverse"))

#aldex data 
aldexdata <- estimated_counts

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  filter(svamp_ID %in% aldexmeta$svamp_ID) %>%
  mutate(svamp_ID = factor(svamp_ID, levels = aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) %>%
  arrange(svamp_ID)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "svamp_ID")

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
    dplyr::select(-c("barcode_shotgun_swab", "after_kraken2_host_removal"))

aldexdata <- t(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- as.data.frame(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% mutate_all(as.numeric)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
  filter(!if_all(everything(), ~ . == 0))

#check if they match names
setdiff(colnames(aldexdata), aldexmeta$svamp_ID) #no differences

setdiff(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, colnames(aldexdata)) #S15

aldexmeta <- aldexmeta %>%
  filter(!svamp_ID %in% c("S15"))

all.equal(names(aldexdata),c(aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) #TRUE


#Get the indices of the names in the same order
order_indices <- match(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, names(aldexdata))

#Reorder the columns to match the order 
aldexdata <- aldexdata[, order_indices]

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
mutate_at(c(1:18), as.integer)

#set the conditions to compare 
conds <-factor(aldexmeta$`Cluster`, levels=c("RVVCpos_seperate", "RVVCpos_diverse")) 

#vector needs to be character 
conds <- as.character(conds)

#aldex
x_all_RVVCpos_cluster <- ALDEx2::aldex(aldexdata, conds, mc.samples=128, test="t", effect=TRUE,
     include.sample.summary=FALSE, denom="all", verbose=FALSE)

x_all_RVVCpos_cluster <- x_all_RVVCpos_cluster %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "species")

write_csv(x_all_RVVCpos_cluster, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/dif_abundance_clusters.csv")

```

## Volcano plot

```{r}
#| label: volcano-RVVCpos
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true


species_levels <- unique(x_all_RVVCpos_cluster$species)
species_count <- length(species_levels)

color_palette_volcano <- setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(species_count), species_levels)

significant_species_difabu <- x_all_RVVCpos_cluster %>%
  filter(abs(diff.btw) > 1 & we.ep < 0.05)

significant_species <- significant_species_difabu$species 

#define cutoffs
fc_cutoff <- 1
p_cutoff <- 0.05

#is the species significant or not 
x_all_RVVCpos_cluster <- x_all_RVVCpos_cluster %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      diff.btw > fc_cutoff & we.ep < p_cutoff ~ "Up",
      diff.btw < -fc_cutoff & we.ep < p_cutoff ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "Non-significant")
  )

#colors
volcano_colors <- c(
  "Up" = "hotpink",          #pink
  "Down" = "#2166ac",        # blue
  "Non-significant" = "gray70"
)

#labels in figure 
sig_species <- x_all_RVVCpos_cluster %>%
  filter(significance != "Non-significant") %>%
  mutate(
    pretty_label = paste0(
      "italic('",
      gsub("_", " ", sub("^s__", "", species)),
      "')"
    )
  )

#volcano plot with cutoffs (significance and fold change)
volcano_RVVCpos_beforeFDR <- ggplot(x_all_RVVCpos_cluster,
                       aes(x = diff.btw, y = -log10(we.ep), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = volcano_colors) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = sig_species,
    aes(label = pretty_label),
    parse = TRUE,
    size = 5,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
    title = "Volcano Plot: RVVCpos_seperate vs RVVCpos_diverse"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

plot(volcano_RVVCpos_beforeFDR)

ggsave(plot = volcano_RVVCpos_beforeFDR, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/volcano_RVVCpos_beforeFDR.png", bg = "white")
```

The main difference in the microbiome between groups are the species Candida albicans and Lactobacillus iners. Both have a higher relative abundance in the separately clustering group of samples.

```{r}
#| label: major-species-RVVCpos

##########################

lacto_vars <- c("s__Lactobacillus_iners", "s__Lactobacillus_crispatus", "s__Lactobacillus_jensenii", "s__Lactobacillus_gasseri", "s__Limosilactobacillus_portuensis", "s__Gardnerella_vaginalis", "s__Candida_albicans")


df_lacto <- samplerows_clustering_merged_renormalized %>%

  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = lacto_vars,
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) 

library(rstatix)

wilcox_results <- df_lacto_long %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%   
  wilcox_test(
    Abundance ~ Cluster,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"  
  )

wilcox_results %>%
gt()

mean_abundance_wide <- df_lacto_long %>%
  group_by(Species, Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster,
    values_from = Mean_Abundance,
    names_prefix = "Mean_Cluster_"
  )

wilcox_results_with_means <- wilcox_results %>%
  left_join(mean_abundance_wide, by = "Species")

wilcox_results_with_means %>%
  gt()

cluster_labels <- c(
  "RVVCpos_diverse" = "Diverse",
  "RVVCpos_seperate" = "Separate"
)

library(stringr)

species_labels <- function(strings) {
  sapply(strings, function(string) {
    sp <- gsub("^s__", "", string)
    parts <- strsplit(sp, "_")[[1]]
    genus <- parts[1]
    species <- parts[2]
    genus_abbrev <- paste0(substr(genus, 1, 1), ".")
    formatted <- paste(genus_abbrev, species)
    as.expression(bquote(.(formatted)))
  })
}

cluster_labels <- c(

species_labels <- function(strings) {
  sapply(strings, function(string) {
    sp <- gsub("^s__", "", string)
    parts <- strsplit(sp, "_")[[1]]
    genus <- parts[1]
    species <- parts[2]

    genus_abbrev <- paste0(substr(genus, 1, 1), ".")
    formatted <- paste(genus_abbrev, species)

    as.expression(bquote(.(formatted)))
  })
}
```

## Heterogeneity

```{r}
#| label: heterogeneity-RVVCposcluster
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

##################################
# HETEROGENEITY TESTING CLUSTERS #
##################################

#species columns from CLR dataframe
species_cols <- grep(
  "^s__",
  colnames(samplerows_clustering_clr),
  value = TRUE
)

#CLR abundance matrix
clr_matrix <- samplerows_clustering_clr[, species_cols]

#cluster variable
clusters <- factor(samplerows_clustering_clr$Cluster)

#euclidean distance on CLR data = Aitchison distance
dist_clr <- dist(clr_matrix, method = "euclidean")

#test dispersion / heterogeneity
dispersion <- betadisper(
  dist_clr,
  group = clusters
)

#overall test
anova(dispersion)

#p = 0.8376 no difference in heterogeneity 


aggregate(
  dispersion$distances,
  by = list(Cluster = clusters),
  FUN = mean
)

aggregate(
  dispersion$distances,
  by = list(Cluster = clusters),
  FUN = median
)

#Diverse 20.56 - Seperate 24.95, so seperate larger distance to centroid and therefore more heterogenous but the statistics dont point to a difference in heterogeneity 


permutest(
  dispersion,
  permutations = 9999
)
#0.8358

dispersion_df <- data.frame(
  Cluster = clusters,
  Distance_to_centroid = dispersion$distances
)

cluster_labels <- c(
  "RVVCpos_diverse" = "Diverse",
  "RVVCpos_seperate" = "Separate"
)

dispersion_cluster <- ggplot(
  dispersion_df,
  aes(x = Cluster, y = Distance_to_centroid)
) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.2,
    fill = "grey70",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.1,
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 2,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = "mean",
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.4,
    color = "#B2007F",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = cluster_labels) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Distance to cluster centroid"
  ) +
  theme_classic()


plot(dispersion_cluster)

ggsave(
  plot = dispersion_cluster,
  "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/dispersion_clusters.png",
  width = 5,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
pretty_taxa_names <- function(x) {

  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x)   
  x
}

clustering_cs_ra_long_RVVCpos_seperate <- clustering_cs_ra_RVVCpos_seperate %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(microbiome_vars_RVVCpos_seperate),
               names_to = "species",
               values_to = "abundance")

cor_results_rvvc_seperate <- clustering_cs_ra_long_RVVCpos_seperate %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(clinical_vars_RVVCpos_seperate),
               names_to = "clinical",
               values_to = "clinical_value") %>%
  group_by(clinical, species) %>%
  summarise(
    result = list(cor.test(clinical_value, abundance, method = "pearson") %>% tidy()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(result)

cor_results_rvvc_seperate <- cor_results_rvvc_seperate %>%
  mutate(p.adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))

sig_rvvc_seperate <- cor_results_rvvc_seperate %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) #nothing after BH


cor_results_rvvc_filtered_seperate <- cor_results_rvvc_seperate %>%
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) %>%
  mutate(significant = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, TRUE, FALSE))


heatmap_mat_rvvc_seperate <- cor_results_rvvc_filtered_seperate %>%
  select(species, clinical, estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clinical, values_from = estimate, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mat_rvvc_seperate <- cor_results_rvvc_filtered_seperate %>%
  select(species, clinical, p.value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clinical, values_from = p.value, values_fill = 1) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mat_rvvc_seperate <- sig_mat_rvvc_seperate < 0.05

pretty_taxa_names <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("s__", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x)   
  x
}

rownames(heatmap_mat_rvvc_seperate) <- pretty_taxa_names(rownames(heatmap_mat_rvvc_seperate))
```

## Heatmap

Species abundance across clusters and clinical scores in a heatmap

```{r}
#| label: heatmap-RVVCposcluster
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

############################
# SPECIES HEATMAP CLUSTERS #
############################

#CLR normalization 
clr_data <- samplerows_clustering_merged_renormalized

clr_data[, 17:70] <- clr(clr_data[, 17:70] + 1e-6)

#only abundance data 
heat_dataclr <- as.matrix(clr_data[, 17:70])

#get rownames from svamp_ID
rownames(heat_dataclr) <- clr_data[[2]]

heat_dataclr_t <- t(heat_dataclr)

#hierarchical clustering
row_hclustclr <- hclust(dist(heat_dataclr_t), method = "ward.D2")   #taxa
col_hclustclr <- hclust(dist(t(heat_dataclr_t)), method = "ward.D2") #samples

#hclust objects to dendrograms
row_dendclr <- as.dendrogram(row_hclustclr)
col_dendclr <- as.dendrogram(col_hclustclr)

#clusters (adjust for how many color groups)
k_row <- 4
k_col <- 3

#colors for each cluster
row_colors <- brewer.pal(k_row, "Pastel1")
col_colors <- brewer.pal(k_col, "Pastel2")

#colors for dendrites
row_dend_colored <- color_branches(row_dendclr, k = k_row, col = row_colors)
col_dend_colored <- color_branches(col_dendclr, k = k_col, col = col_colors)

#taxa names adjusted and in italics
pretty_taxa_names <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("s__", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x)   
  x
}

rownames(heat_dataclr_t) <- pretty_taxa_names(rownames(heat_dataclr_t))

#extract group column 
sample_groups <- clr_data$Cluster
names(sample_groups) <- colnames(heat_dataclr_t)

#color for each group
group_levels <- unique(sample_groups)
group_colors <- c("#80B1D3", "#A8D5BA")
names(group_colors) <- group_levels


#bar above heatmap - clinical score
clr_data_cs <- clr_data %>%
left_join(clinical_score_rvvc, by = "svamp_ID")

clinical_score_fac <- clr_data_cs %>%
  select(svamp_ID, `Clinical score (0-5)`) %>%
  filter(svamp_ID %in% colnames(heat_dataclr_t)) %>%
  arrange(match(svamp_ID, colnames(heat_dataclr_t))) %>%
  pull(`Clinical score (0-5)`) %>%
  factor(levels = 0:5, ordered = TRUE)

score_colors <- setNames(
  brewer.pal(6, "YlOrRd"),
  levels(clinical_score_fac)
)


#bar above heatmap - group cluster
col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = sample_groups,
  col = list(Group = group_colors),
  annotation_legend_param = list(title = "Sample Group")
)


col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = sample_groups,
  ClinicalScore = clinical_score_fac,
  col = list(
    Group = group_colors,
    ClinicalScore = score_colors
  ),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Group = list(title = "Sample Group"),
    ClinicalScore = list(title = "Clinical score (0–5)")
  )
)

png("~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/heatmap_RVVCpos_both_clusters.png", width = 2000, height = 2000, res = 300)
  
heatmap_clr_plot <- Heatmap(
  heat_dataclr_t,
  name = "clr(Abundance)",

    c(min(heat_dataclr_t), 0, max(heat_dataclr_t)),

  ),

  top_annotation = col_ha
)

dev.off()
```

## Network

Species-species correlation network

```{r}
#| label: network-RVVCposcluster
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#####################
# NETWORKS CLUSTERS #
#####################

species_mat_seperate <- samplerows_clustering_merged_renormalized %>% filter(Cluster == "RVVCpos_seperate")
species_mat_diverse   <- samplerows_clustering_merged_renormalized %>% filter(Cluster == "RVVCpos_diverse")

species_mat_seperate <- species_mat_seperate[, -(1:16)]

species_mat_diverse <- species_mat_diverse[, -(1:16)]

species_mat_seperate <- species_mat_seperate[, -(55:56)]

species_mat_diverse <- species_mat_diverse[, -(55:56)]

#remove species columns with zero variance (cannot be correlated)
species_mat_seperate <- species_mat_seperate[, apply(species_mat_seperate, 2, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)]

species_mat_diverse  <- species_mat_diverse[,  apply(species_mat_diverse, 2, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)]



cor_mat_seperate <- cor(species_mat_seperate, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cor_mat_diverse <- cor(species_mat_diverse, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

                                                     
cor_mat_seperate_df <- as.data.frame(cor_mat_seperate) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("species")

cor_mat_diverse_df <- as.data.frame(cor_mat_diverse) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("species")

write_csv(cor_mat_seperate_df,
          "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/network_RVVCpos_seperate_correlation.csv")

write_csv(cor_mat_diverse_df,
          "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/network_RVVCpos_diverse_correlation.csv") 
                                                     

cor_p_seperate <- corPvalueStudent(cor_mat_seperate, nrow(species_mat_seperate))

cor_p_diverse <- corPvalueStudent(cor_mat_diverse, nrow(species_mat_diverse))


cor_p_seperate_df <- as.data.frame(cor_p_seperate) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("species")

cor_p_diverse_df <- as.data.frame(cor_p_diverse) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("species")

write_csv(cor_p_seperate_df,
          "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/network_RVVCpos_seperate.csv")

write_csv(cor_p_diverse_df,
          "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/network_RVVCpos_diverse.csv")                                                     

#TOP 15 species 
#parameters ---
threshold <- 0.3    
p_threshold <- 0.05  

#list of species you want labeled
top15_species <- c(
  "s__Lactobacillus_crispatus",
  "s__Lactobacillus_iners",
  "s__Lactobacillus_gasseri",
  "s__Lactobacillus_jensenii",
  "s__Gardnerella_vaginalis",
  "s__Fannyhessea_vaginae",
  "s__Streptococcus_agalactiae",
  "s__Limosilactobacillus_portuensis",
  "s__Staphylococcus_aureus",
  "s__Prevotella_bivia",
  "other",
  "s__Dialister_micraerophilus",
  "s__Ureaplasma_parvum",
  "s__Aerococcus_christensenii",
  "s__Candida_albicans",
  "s__Megasphaera_lornae"
)

#filter significant correlations 
sig_mat_seperate <- cor_mat_seperate
sig_mat_seperate[abs(cor_mat_seperate) < threshold | cor_p_seperate > p_threshold] <- 0
diag(sig_mat_seperate) <- 0

sig_mat_diverse <- cor_mat_diverse
sig_mat_diverse[abs(cor_mat_diverse) < threshold | cor_p_diverse > p_threshold] <- 0
diag(sig_mat_diverse) <- 0

#create graph
g_diverse <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(sig_mat_diverse, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)

g_seperate <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(sig_mat_seperate, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)

#remove isolated nodes
g_diverse <- delete_vertices(g_diverse, degree(g_diverse) == 0)

g_seperate <- delete_vertices(g_seperate, degree(g_seperate) == 0)

#vertex attributes
V(g_diverse)$abundance <- colMeans(species_mat_diverse)[V(g_diverse)$name]

V(g_seperate)$abundance <- colMeans(species_mat_seperate)[V(g_seperate)$name]

#clustering (Louvain)
cluster_weights_diverse <- E(g_diverse)$weight
cluster_weights_diverse[cluster_weights_diverse < 0] <- 0
cl_diverse <- cluster_louvain(g_diverse, weights = cluster_weights_diverse)
V(g_diverse)$cluster <- cl_diverse$membership

cluster_weights_seperate <- E(g_seperate)$weight
cluster_weights_seperate[cluster_weights_seperate < 0] <- 0
cl_seperate <- cluster_louvain(g_seperate, weights = cluster_weights_seperate)
V(g_seperate)$cluster <- cl_seperate$membership

#cluster colors
num_clusters_diverse <- max(cl_diverse$membership)
cluster_colors_diverse <- brewer.pal(min(num_clusters_diverse, 12), "Set3")
V(g_diverse)$color <- cluster_colors_diverse[V(g_diverse)$cluster]

num_clusters_seperate <- max(cl_seperate$membership)
cluster_colors_seperate <- brewer.pal(min(num_clusters_seperate, 12), "Set3")
V(g_seperate)$color <- cluster_colors_seperate[V(g_seperate)$cluster]

#edge aesthetics
E(g_diverse)$sign <- ifelse(E(g_diverse)$weight > 0, "positive", "negative")
E(g_diverse)$alpha <- abs(E(g_diverse)$weight)

E(g_seperate)$sign <- ifelse(E(g_seperate)$weight > 0, "positive", "negative")
E(g_seperate)$alpha <- abs(E(g_seperate)$weight)
  
#layout (FR with positive weights)
g_layout_diverse <- g_diverse
E(g_layout_diverse)$weight <- abs(E(g_layout_diverse)$weight)
set.seed(123)
layout_diverse <- create_layout(g_layout_diverse, layout = "fr")

g_layout_seperate <- g_seperate
E(g_layout_seperate)$weight <- abs(E(g_layout_seperate)$weight)
set.seed(123)
layout_seperate <- create_layout(g_layout_seperate, layout = "fr")

#label ONLY if node name is in top15_species
layout_diverse$label <- ifelse(V(g_diverse)$name %in% top15_species, V(g_diverse)$name, "")

layout_seperate$label <- ifelse(V(g_seperate)$name %in% top15_species, V(g_seperate)$name, "")

#plot
network_RVVCpos_diverse <- ggraph(layout_diverse) +
  geom_edge_link(aes(color = sign, alpha = alpha, width = alpha),
                 show.legend = TRUE, lineend = "round") +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("positive" = "#1B9E77",
                                     "negative" = "#D95F02")) +
  scale_edge_alpha(range = c(0.2, 0.9)) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.4, 2)) +
  geom_node_point(aes(size = abundance, fill = factor(cluster)),
                  shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.4) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 12)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors_diverse) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = label),
                 repel = TRUE,
                 size = 3,
                 point.padding = 0.2,
                 max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  ) +
  guides(
    size       = guide_legend("Mean abundance"),
    fill       = guide_legend("Cluster"),
    edge_color = guide_legend("Correlation sign"),
    edge_width = "none",
    edge_alpha = "none"
  )

plot(network_RVVCpos_diverse)

ggsave(plot = network_RVVCpos_diverse,  "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/251218_network_RVVCpos_diverse.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")                                                     
                                                     
#plot
network_RVVCpos_seperate <- ggraph(layout_seperate) +
  geom_edge_link(aes(color = sign, alpha = alpha, width = alpha),
                 show.legend = TRUE, lineend = "round") +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("positive" = "#1B9E77",
                                     "negative" = "#D95F02")) +
  scale_edge_alpha(range = c(0.2, 0.9)) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.4, 2)) +
  geom_node_point(aes(size = abundance, fill = factor(cluster)),
                  shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.4) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 12)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors_seperate) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = label),
                 repel = TRUE,
                 size = 3,
                 point.padding = 0.2,
                 max.overlaps = 10) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  ) +
  guides(
    size       = guide_legend("Mean abundance"),
    fill       = guide_legend("Cluster"),
    edge_color = guide_legend("Correlation sign"),
    edge_width = "none",
    edge_alpha = "none"
  )

plot(network_RVVCpos_seperate)  

ggsave(plot = network_RVVCpos_seperate,  "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/251218_network_RVVCpos_seperate.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## Barplot per cluster

```{r}
#| label: barplot-RVVCposcluster
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

####################
# BARPLOT CLUSTERS #
####################

df_rel <- ra_samplerows_long_other_cross %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Species) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  mutate(rel_abundance = total_abundance / sum(total_abundance)) %>%
  ungroup()

barplot_RVVCpos_clusters <- ggplot(df_rel, aes(x = Cluster, y = rel_abundance, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "RVVCpos Cluster",
    y = "Relative abundance (%)",
    fill = "Species",
    title = "Species composition by Cluster"
  ) +
```

## Differential abundance per clinical feature (yes/no)

Comparing species composition when a clinical feature is present or not

```{r}
#| label: aldex2-RVVCposcluster
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true
#| results: 'hide'

############################################
# DIFFERENTIAL ABUNDANCE CLINICAL FEATURES #
############################################

#make the clinical features into factors with levels 0 and 1 
clustering_cs_ra <- clustering_cs_ra %>%
mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("Clinical score:"),
      ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1))
    )
  )

#hyphae present yes or no 

#aldex metadata 
aldexmeta <- clustering_cs_ra 

#aldex data 
aldexdata <- estimated_counts

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  filter(svamp_ID %in% aldexmeta$svamp_ID) %>%
  mutate(svamp_ID = factor(svamp_ID, levels = aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) %>%
  arrange(svamp_ID)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "svamp_ID")

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
    dplyr::select(-c("barcode_shotgun_swab", "after_kraken2_host_removal"))

aldexdata <- t(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- as.data.frame(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% mutate_all(as.numeric)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
  filter(!if_all(everything(), ~ . == 0))

#check if they match names
setdiff(colnames(aldexdata), aldexmeta$svamp_ID) #no differences

setdiff(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, colnames(aldexdata)) #S15

aldexmeta <- aldexmeta %>%
  filter(!svamp_ID %in% c("S15"))

all.equal(names(aldexdata),c(aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) #TRUE


#Get the indices of the names in the same order
order_indices <- match(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, names(aldexdata))

#Reorder the columns to match the order 
aldexdata <- aldexdata[, order_indices]

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
mutate_at(c(1:18), as.integer)

#set the conditions to compare 
conds <-factor(aldexmeta$`Clinical score: hyphae (y/n)`, levels=c("0", "1")) 

#vector needs to be character
```
