## Volcano plots clinical features

```{r}
#| label: volcano-features-RVVCposcluster
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

# define cutoffs
fc_cutoff <- 1
p_cutoff <- 0.05

# find all dfs starting with x_all and ending with _score
df_names <- ls(pattern = "^x_all.*_cluster_")

# create empty list to store plots
volcano_plots_features <- list()

# loop over each df name
for (nm in df_names) {

  df <- get(nm)

  # get species info
  species_levels <- unique(df$species)
  species_count <- length(species_levels)

  color_palette_volcano <- setNames(
    colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(species_count),
    species_levels
  )

  # define significance based on fold change and p-value
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      significance = case_when(
        diff.btw > fc_cutoff & we.ep < p_cutoff ~ "Up",
        diff.btw < -fc_cutoff & we.ep < p_cutoff ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "Non-significant"
      )
    )

  # prepare significant species labels
  sig_species <- df %>%
    filter(significance != "Non-significant") %>%
    mutate(
      pretty_label = paste0(
        "italic('",
        gsub("_", " ", sub("^s__", "", species)),
        "')"
      )
    )

  # define volcano plot colors
  volcano_colors <- c(
    "Up" = "hotpink",
    "Down" = "#2166ac",
    "Non-significant" = "gray70"
  )

  # create volcano plot
  p_features <- ggplot(df, aes(x = diff.btw, y = -log10(we.ep), color = significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = volcano_colors) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = sig_species,
      aes(label = pretty_label),
      parse = TRUE,
      size = 5,
      box.padding = 0.5,
      point.padding = 0.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
      title = paste0("Volcano Plot: ", nm)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

  # store in list
  volcano_plots_features[[nm]] <- p_features
  
}

# view all plots in the list
volcano_plots_features

ggsave(plot = volcano_plots_features[["x_all_RVVCpos_cluster_discharge"]], "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/251218_volcano_plot_RVVCposcluster_discharge.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)  

ggsave(plot = volcano_plots_features[["x_all_RVVCpos_cluster_dryness"]], "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/251218_volcano_plot_RVVCposcluster_dryness.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)  

ggsave(plot = volcano_plots_features[["x_all_RVVCpos_cluster_fissures"]], "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/251218_volcano_plot_RVVCposcluster_fissures.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)  

ggsave(plot = volcano_plots_features[["x_all_RVVCpos_cluster_hyphae"]], "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/251218_volcano_plot_RVVCposcluster_hyphae.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)  

ggsave(plot = volcano_plots_features[["x_all_RVVCpos_cluster_redness"]], "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/RVVCpos clusters/251218_volcano_plot_RVVCposcluster_redness.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## PCoA highlighted with clinical features

PCoA made previously on all cross-sectional data points colored by whether or not the patient data points are from clustering points. Data points are also extra circled when a specific clinical feature is present for that participant

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-RVVCposcluster
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#################
# PCOA CLUSTERS #
#################

#use the previously made PCoA plots (cross sectional and clinical score one) and only color these RVVCpos cluster points and all the other points are made grey 

meta_dysp_clusterrvvc <- meta_dysp_cross %>% 
  left_join(
    meta_dysp_rvvc %>% select(svamp_ID, Cluster),
    by = "svamp_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    color_group = ifelse(is.na(Cluster), "background", Cluster)
  )

meta_dysp_clusterrvvc <- meta_dysp_clusterrvvc %>%
  left_join(
      clinical_score_rvvc %>% select(svamp_ID,`Clinical score: discharge (y/n)`, `Clinical score: dryness (y/n)`, `Clinical score: fissures (y/n)`, `Clinical score: hyphae (y/n)`, `Clinical score: redness (y/n)`), 
      by = "svamp_ID"
  )

meta_dysp_clusterrvvc <- meta_dysp_clusterrvvc %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster_label = case_when(
      Cluster == "RVVCpos_diverse"  ~ "Diverse",
      Cluster == "RVVCpos_seperate" ~ "Separate",
      TRUE                          ~ "Not RVVCpos"   
    )
  )


my_cols <- c(
  "Not RVVCpos" = "grey80",
  "Diverse"     = "#A8D5BA",
  "Separate"    = "#80B1D3"
)


pcoa_cross_clusterrvvc <- ggplot(meta_dysp_clusterrvvc, aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2)) +
  xlim(-2.5, 3) +
  ylim(-2.5, 2.5) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Cluster_label), size = 8, alpha = 0.8) +

  stat_ellipse(
    aes(group = Cluster, color = Cluster_label),
    type = "t",
    level = 0.95,
    linetype = 1,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = my_cols, na.translate = FALSE) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("MDS Bray RVVCpos Clusters") +
  #scale_x_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  #scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
 #coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.2, 1.2), ylim = c(-1.2, 1.7)) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20)
```

# Candida presence as a binary value

Metagenomics based detection of C. albicans can be used as a determinant of the presence or absence of Candida in patient samples and thus turned into a binary value for further analysis

## Make a binary value out of abundance data

```{r}
#| label: candida-value
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

########################
# CANDIDA BINARY VALUE #
########################

merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_cs_candida <- merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_cs %>%
 mutate(
    candida_present = if_else(
      s__Candida_albicans > 0,
      1L,
      0L
    )
  )

```

## Permanova

```{r}
#| label: permanova-candida-present
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

############################
# PERMANOVA CANDIDA BINARY #
############################

vegan::adonis2(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_cs_candida[,17:70]~candida_present, data = merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_cs_candida, na.action = na.omit, permutations = 999,method="bray")
```

## Anosim

```{r}
#| label: anosim-candida-present
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#########################
# ANOSIM CANDIDA BINARY #
#########################

anosim(dist_matrix_cross, group = merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_cs_candida$candida_present, permutations = 999)
```

## Differential abundance analysis

```{r}
#| label: aldex-candida-present
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#########################################
# DIFFERENTIAL ABUNDANCE CANDIDA BINARY #
#########################################

#aldex metadata 
aldexmeta <- merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_cs_candida %>%
  filter(candida_present %in% c("0", "1"))

#aldex data 
aldexdata <- estimated_counts

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  filter(svamp_ID %in% aldexmeta$svamp_ID) %>%
  mutate(svamp_ID = factor(svamp_ID, levels = aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) %>%
  arrange(svamp_ID)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "svamp_ID")

aldexdata <- t(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- as.data.frame(aldexdata)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>% mutate_all(as.numeric)

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
  filter(!if_all(everything(), ~ . == 0))

aldexdata <- aldexdata[rownames(aldexdata) != "after_kraken2_host_removal", ]

#check if they match names
setdiff(colnames(aldexdata), aldexmeta$svamp_ID) #no differences

setdiff(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, colnames(aldexdata)) #no differences

#aldexmeta <- aldexmeta %>%
  #filter(svamp_ID != "S15")

all.equal(names(aldexdata),c(aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) #TRUE


#Get the indices of the names in the same order
order_indices <- match(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, names(aldexdata))

#Reorder the columns to match the order 
aldexdata <- aldexdata[, order_indices]

aldexdata <- aldexdata %>%
mutate_at(c(1:78), as.integer)

#set the conditions to compare 
conds <-factor(aldexmeta$candida_present, levels=c("0", "1")) 

#vector needs to be character 
conds <- as.character(conds)

#aldex
x_all_candida_0_1 <- ALDEx2::aldex(aldexdata, conds, mc.samples=128, test="t", effect=TRUE,
     include.sample.summary=FALSE, denom="all", verbose=FALSE)

x_all_candida_0_1 <- x_all_candida_0_1 %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "species")

write_csv(x_all_candida_0_1, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/differential abundance/251121_VMBcandida_luminal_cross_sectional_dif_abundance_candida_0_1.csv")

```

# RVVCcul.pos VS CTRLcul.neg

All analysis performed on the four cross-sectional groups is repeated on only the RVVCcul.pos (RVVCpos) and CTRLcul.neg (Control) groups. These are both n = 30 groups and will give the most statistical relevant findings.

## Select samples

```{r}
#| label: pos-vs-control-selection
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

####################################
# SAMPLE SELECTION RVVCPOS CONTROL #
####################################

#select samples in only RVVCpos and Control 
merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison <- merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional %>%
  filter(group_cross %in% c("Control", "RVVCpos"))
```

## Permanova

```{r}
#| label: pos-vs-control-permanova
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#############################
# PERMANOVA RVVCPOS CONTROL #
#############################

vegan::adonis2(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison[,17:70]~group_cross, data = merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison, na.action = na.omit, permutations = 999,method="bray") #0.045

#how much is due to candida and group 
vegan::adonis2(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison[,17:70]~s__Candida_albicans+group_cross, data = merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison, na.action = na.omit, permutations = 999,method="bray") #0.004

#candida and group as individual predictors
vegan::adonis2(
  merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison[, 17:70] ~ 
    s__Candida_albicans + group_cross,
  data = merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison,
  permutations = 999,
  method = "bray",
  by = "margin"
)
#candida 0.013
#group_cross 0.170

#individual predictors without candida in the matrix 
taxa_matrix_nocandida <- 
  merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison[, 17:70] %>%
  dplyr::select(-s__Candida_albicans)

vegan::adonis2(
  taxa_matrix_nocandida ~ s__Candida_albicans + group_cross,
  data = merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison,
  permutations = 999,
  method = "bray",
  na.action = na.omit,
  by = "margin"
)

```

## Alpha diversity

Shannon, Inverse Simpson and Species number

```{r}
#| label: pos-vs-control-alpha
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

###################################
# ALPHA DIVERSITY RVVCPOS CONTROL #
###################################

merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison_alpha <-
  merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison %>%
  column_to_rownames("svamp_ID") %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison_alpha <- merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison_alpha %>%
select(-metabolomics_run_order)

shann_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison_alpha,index = c("shannon") )
simp_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison_alpha,index  = c("simpson") )
invsimp_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison_alpha,index  = c("invsimpson") )
spec_cross_df <-as.numeric(vegan::specnumber(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison_alpha))
divers_cross <- as.matrix(rbind(shann_cross_df,simp_cross_df,invsimp_cross_df,spec_cross_df) )
divers_cross[is.infinite(divers_cross)] <- 0
rownames(divers_cross) <- c("Shannon","simpson","Inv Simpson","SpecNo")

divers_t_cross <-as.data.frame(t(divers_cross)) #%>%
  #mutate(svamp_ID=colnames(divers_cross))

divers_t_cross <- divers_t_cross %>%
  rownames_to_column("svamp_ID")

metadata_divers_cross <- sample_identification_cross %>%
  left_join(divers_t_cross, by = "svamp_ID")

metadata_divers_cross <- metadata_divers_cross %>%
  mutate(group_cross = factor(group_cross, 
                                  levels = c("RVVCpos", "Control")))

metadata_divers_cross <- metadata_divers_cross %>%
filter(group_cross %in% c("Control", "RVVCpos"))

write_csv(metadata_divers_cross, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/comparison/alpha_diversity_rvvculpos_ctrlculneg.csv")

shann2_cross <- ggplot(metadata_divers_cross, aes (x=group_cross,y=Shannon,group=group_cross)) +
  geom_violin() +
  #geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(height = .2, width = .05)) +
  geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.2, size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", width = 0.8,colour = "#B2007F", linewidth = 1.5)+theme_classic()+ggtitle("Shannon") +
  #stat_compare_means(label="p.signif",comparisons = list(c("RVVCpos","RVVCneg"),c("RVVCpos","AS"),c("RVVCpos","Control"),c("RVVCneg","AS"),c("RVVCneg","Control"),c("AS","Control")), hide.ns = FALSE, size = 10, bracket.size = 2 ) +
  labs(y = "Shannon", title = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(
  limits = c("RVVCpos", "Control"),
  labels = c(
```

## Differential abundance analysis + volcano plot

Done previously in cross-sectional grouping (RVVCpos VS Control) but perform one at the genus level here.

```{r}
#| label: pos-vs-control-aldex2-genus
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

######################################################
# DIFFERENTIAL ABUNDANCE GENUS LEVEL RVVCPOS CONTROL #
######################################################

#aldex metadata 
aldexmeta <- sample_identification %>%
  filter(group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "Control"))

#aldex data 
aldexdata <- estimated_counts

#identify only the species columns
species_cols <- grep("^s__", colnames(aldexdata), value = TRUE)

#extract genus:
# s__Lactobacillus_crispatus -> Lactobacillus
genus <- sub("^s__([^_]+).*", "\\1", species_cols)

# Sum species belonging to the same genus
genus_data <- sapply(unique(genus), function(g) {
  rowSums(aldexdata[, species_cols[genus == g], drop = FALSE])
})

#convert to data frame
genus_data <- as.data.frame(genus_data)

#add metadata columns back
metadata_cols <- setdiff(colnames(aldexdata), species_cols)

aldexdata_genus <- cbind(
  genus_data,
  aldexdata[, metadata_cols, drop = FALSE]
)

#rest of code as usual 
aldexdata_genus <- aldexdata_genus %>% 
  filter(svamp_ID %in% aldexmeta$svamp_ID) %>%
  mutate(svamp_ID = factor(svamp_ID, levels = aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) %>%
  arrange(svamp_ID)

aldexdata_genus <- aldexdata_genus %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "svamp_ID")

aldexdata_genus <- t(aldexdata_genus)

aldexdata_genus <- as.data.frame(aldexdata_genus)

aldexdata_genus <- aldexdata_genus %>% mutate_all(as.numeric)

aldexdata_genus <- aldexdata_genus %>%
  filter(!if_all(everything(), ~ . == 0))

aldexdata_genus <- aldexdata_genus[rownames(aldexdata_genus) != "after_kraken2_host_removal", ]

#check if they match names
setdiff(colnames(aldexdata_genus), aldexmeta$svamp_ID) #no differences

setdiff(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, colnames(aldexdata_genus)) #S15, S10

aldexmeta <- aldexmeta %>%
  filter(!svamp_ID %in% c("S15", "S10"))

all.equal(names(aldexdata_genus),c(aldexmeta$svamp_ID)) #TRUE


#Get the indices of the names in the same order
order_indices <- match(aldexmeta$svamp_ID, names(aldexdata_genus))

#Reorder the columns to match the order 
aldexdata_genus <- aldexdata_genus[, order_indices]

aldexdata_genus <- aldexdata_genus %>%
mutate_at(c(1:60), as.integer)

#set the conditions to compare 
conds <-factor(aldexmeta$group_cross, levels=c("RVVCpos", "Control")) 

#vector needs to be character 
conds <- as.character(conds)

#aldex
x_all_RVVCpos_Control_cross_genus <- ALDEx2::aldex(aldexdata_genus, conds, mc.samples=128, test="t", effect=TRUE,
     include.sample.summary=FALSE, denom="all", verbose=FALSE)

x_all_RVVCpos_Control_cross_genus <- x_all_RVVCpos_Control_cross_genus %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "genus")


write_csv(x_all_RVVCpos_Control_cross_genus, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/comparison/dif_abundance_RVVCpos_Control_genus.csv")

```

```{r}
ra_samplerows_cross <- merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison 

#take only the 15 most abundant taxa for the graph all the others can be combined into an other category

#data in long format 
ra_samplerows_long_cross <- ra_samplerows_cross %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("s__"),
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )

#rename all the taxa that are not in top 15 to other
accepted_species_cross <- c("s__Lactobacillus_crispatus", "s__Lactobacillus_iners", "s__Gardnerella_vaginalis", "s__Lactobacillus_jensenii", "s__Lactobacillus_gasseri", "s__Fannyhessea_vaginae", "s__Aerococcus_christensenii", "s__Megasphaera_lornae", "s__Limosilactobacillus_portuensis","s__Staphylococcus_aureus","s__Prevotella_bivia", "s__Streptococcus_agalactiae", "s__Candida_albicans", "s__Ureaplasma_parvum", "s__Dialister_micraerophilus")                        

ra_samplerows_long_other_cross <- ra_samplerows_long_cross %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species %in% accepted_species_cross, Species, "other"))

df_rel <- ra_samplerows_long_other_cross %>%
  group_by(group_cross, Species) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(group_cross) %>%
  mutate(rel_abundance = total_abundance / sum(total_abundance)) %>%
  ungroup()

ra_cross_all <- ggplot(df_rel, aes(x = group_cross, y = rel_abundance, fill = Species)) +

  ) +

  }
)

library(stringr)

species_labels <- function(strings) {
  sapply(strings, function(string) {
    sp <- gsub("^s__", "", string)
    parts <- strsplit(sp, "_")[[1]]
    genus <- parts[1]
    species <- parts[2]
    genus_abbrev <- paste0(substr(genus, 1, 1), ".")
    formatted <- paste(genus_abbrev, species)
    as.expression(bquote(.(formatted)))
  })
}

lacto_species_violin <- ggplot(df_lacto_long, aes(x = group_cross, y = Abundance)) +

    alpha = 0.2,

    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0),
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 1.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = "mean",
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.4,
    color = "#B2007F",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
 stat_compare_means(
    label = "p.signif",
    comparisons = list(
      c("RVVCpos", "Control")
    ),
    size = 6,
    bracket.size = 0,
    tip.length = 0,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
  limits = c("RVVCpos", "Control"),
  labels = c(
    expression(RVVC^"cul.pos"),
    expression(CTRL^"cul.neg")
  )
) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Species,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = labeller(Species = species_labels)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "italic"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Relative abundance (%)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

  )

#convert to long format
df_lacto_long_clr <- df_lacto_clr %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(lacto_vars),
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "CLR_abundance"
  )

species_labels <- function(strings) {
  sapply(strings, function(string) {

    sp <- gsub("^s__", "", string)
    parts <- strsplit(sp, "_")[[1]]

    genus <- parts[1]
    species <- parts[2]

    genus_abbrev <- paste0(substr(genus, 1, 1), ".")
    formatted <- paste(genus_abbrev, species)

    as.expression(bquote(italic(.(formatted))))
  })
}

lacto_species_violin_clr <- ggplot(
  df_lacto_long_clr,
  aes(x = group_cross, y = CLR_abundance)
) +

  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.2,
    fill = "grey70",
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0),
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 1.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    fun = "mean",
    geom = "crossbar",
    width = 0.4,
    color = "#B2007F",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    comparisons = list(
      c("RVVCpos", "Control")
    ),
    size = 6,
    bracket.size = 0,
    tip.length = 0,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("RVVCpos", "Control"),
    labels = c(
      expression(RVVC^"cul.pos"),
      expression(CTRL^"cul.neg")
    )
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ Species,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = labeller(Species = species_labels)
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 12
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "italic"
    ),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_blank()
  ) +

  labs(
    y = "CLR-transformed abundance"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

plot(lacto_species_violin_clr)

ggsave(
  plot = lacto_species_violin_clr,
  "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/comparison/species_violin_CLR.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

wilcox_lacto_clr <- df_lacto_long_clr %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  wilcox_test(
    CLR_abundance ~ group_cross
  ) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(
    method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

wilcox_lacto_clr %>%
  gt()
```

```{r}
#hierarchical clustering
row_hclustclr <- hclust(dist(heat_dataclr_t), method = "ward.D2")   #taxa
col_hclustclr <- hclust(dist(t(heat_dataclr_t)), method = "ward.D2") #samples

#hclust objects to dendrograms
row_dendclr <- as.dendrogram(row_hclustclr)
col_dendclr <- as.dendrogram(col_hclustclr)

#clusters (adjust for how many color groups)
k_row <- 4
k_col <- 3

#colors for each cluster
row_colors <- brewer.pal(k_row, "Pastel1")
col_colors <- brewer.pal(k_col, "Pastel2")

#colors for dendrites
row_dend_colored <- color_branches(row_dendclr, k = k_row, col = row_colors)
col_dend_colored <- color_branches(col_dendclr, k = k_col, col = col_colors)

#taxa names adjusted and in italics
pretty_taxa_names <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("s__", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x)   
  x
}

rownames(heat_dataclr_t) <- pretty_taxa_names(rownames(heat_dataclr_t))
```

## Correlation between clinical features

```{r}
#| label: rvvc-cs-correlation-features
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

####################################################
# CLINICAL FEATURE CORRELATION CLINICAL SCORE RVVC #
####################################################

clinical_num <- clinical_score %>%
  dplyr::select(contains("(y/n)")) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

cor_matrix <- cor(clinical_num, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

write.csv(
  cbind(feature = rownames(cor_matrix), as.data.frame(cor_matrix)),
  "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/correlation_matrix_features-features.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cor_df <- cor_matrix %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Feature")

cor_df %>%
  gt()

cor_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_matrix)) %>%
  rename(var1 = Var1, var2 = Var2, correlation = Freq)

pairwise_correlations_plot <- ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = var1, y = var2, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#FADADD", mid = "white", high = "#B2007F", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "Pairwise correlations among clinical features") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plot(pairwise_correlations_plot)

ggsave(plot = pairwise_correlations_plot, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/pairwise_correlation_clinical_features.png", width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)



library(psych)

res <- corr.test(
  clinical_num,
  method = "spearman",
  adjust = "BH"
)

#correlation coefficients
cor_matrix <- res$r

#BH-adjusted p-values
p_matrix <- res$p

combined <- matrix(
  paste0(
    sprintf("%.2f", cor_matrix),
    " (p=",
    sprintf("%.3f", p_matrix),
    ")"
  ),
  nrow = nrow(cor_matrix),
  dimnames = dimnames(cor_matrix)
)

write.csv(
  cbind(feature = rownames(combined), as.data.frame(combined)),
  "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/correlation_with_BH_pvalues.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Correlation clinical features and clinical score

```{r}
#| label: rvvc-cs-correlation-features-cs
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#########################################################
# CORRELATION CLINICAL FEATURES AND CLINICAL SCORE RVVC #
#########################################################

clinical_num <- clinical_score %>%
  dplyr::select(`Clinical score (0-5)`, contains("(y/n)"))

clinical_num <- clinical_num %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))))

cor_features_score <- map_dfr(
  names(clinical_num)[-1],
  ~ cor.test(
    clinical_num[["Clinical score (0-5)"]],
    clinical_num[[.x]],
    method = "spearman"
  ) %>%
    broom::tidy() %>%
    mutate(variable = .x)
)

cor_features_score <- cor_features_score %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, estimate, p.value) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate)))

cor_features_score %>%
gt() %>%
cols_label(variable = "Feature")

write.csv(
  cbind(feature = rownames(cor_features_score), as.data.frame(cor_features_score)),
  "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/correlation_matrix_features_clinical_score.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

plot_features_score_correlation <- cor_features_score %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(variable, estimate), y = estimate, fill = p.value < 0.05)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#B2007F",   
               "FALSE" = "gray80"),  
    name = "Significant (p < 0.05)"
  ) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Spearman correlation with overall clinical score") +
  theme_minimal()

plot(plot_features_score_correlation)

ggsave(plot = plot_features_score_correlation, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/spearman_correlation_clinical_score_features.png", width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)

#differences in correlations between groups 
clinical_score <- clinical_score %>%
    mutate(across(-c(1,2), as.numeric))

grouped_score <- clinical_score %>%
  group_split(group_cross)

group_names <- unique(clinical_score$group_cross)

correlations_by_group <- map2_dfr(
  grouped_score,
  group_names,
  ~ {
    data <- .x
    group_name <- .y

    #proceed if there’s variation in the clinical score
    if (length(unique(data[["Clinical score (0-5)"]])) < 2) {
      return(tibble(group = group_name, variable = NA_character_, estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
    }

    results <- map_dfr(
      names(data)[-(1:2)],  
      ~ {
        x <- data[["Clinical score (0-5)"]]
        y <- data[[.x]]

        res <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman"), error = function(e) NULL))

        if (is.null(res)) {
          tibble(variable = .x, estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)
        } else {
          tibble(variable = .x, estimate = res$estimate, p.value = res$p.value)
        }
      }
    )

    results %>%
      mutate(group = group_name)
  }
) %>%
  dplyr::select(group, variable, estimate, p.value) %>%
  arrange(group, desc(abs(estimate)))

correlations_by_group %>%
gt()

write_csv(correlations_by_group, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/group_correlations.csv")
```

## Permanova

```{r}
#| label: rvvc-cs-beta
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

#################################
# PERMANOVA CLINICAL SCORE RVVC #
#################################

clinical_score <- clinical_score %>%
    left_join(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional %>% dplyr::select("sample_rowname", "svamp_ID"), by = "svamp_ID")

merged_clinical_score <- left_join(clinical_score, mpa4_samplerows_cross_sectional_filtered_renormalized_cs)

merged_clinical_score$group_score <- factor(merged_clinical_score$`Clinical score (0-5)`, 
                                                        levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5"))

merged_clinical_score <- merged_clinical_score %>%
    drop_na()

#permanova with clinical score as a gradient
vegan::adonis2(merged_clinical_score[,10:63]~ as.numeric(group_score), data = merged_clinical_score, na.action = na.omit, permutations = 999,method="bray") #0.036

#clinical score not as an ordinal value
vegan::adonis2(
  merged_clinical_score[, 10:63] ~ group_score,
  data = merged_clinical_score,
  na.action = na.omit,
  permutations = 999,
  method = "bray"
)


#check dispersion 
bd <- betadisper(
  vegdist(merged_clinical_score[, 10:63], method = "bray"),
  as.numeric(merged_clinical_score$group_score)
)
anova(bd)   #0.9229

#number of participants per clinical score group
clinical_score %>%
  count(`Clinical score (0-5)`)
```

```{r}
#only the top 15 species are maitained and the rest is summed to a other category 
accepted_species_cross <- c("s__Lactobacillus_crispatus", "s__Lactobacillus_iners", "s__Gardnerella_vaginalis", "s__Lactobacillus_jensenii", "s__Lactobacillus_gasseri", "s__Fannyhessea_vaginae", "s__Aerococcus_christensenii", "s__Megasphaera_lornae", "s__Limosilactobacillus_portuensis","s__Staphylococcus_aureus","s__Prevotella_bivia", "s__Streptococcus_agalactiae", "s__Candida_albicans", "s__Ureaplasma_parvum", "s__Dialister_micraerophilus")                         

rel_abund_cross_cs_long <- rel_abund_cross_cs_long %>%
  mutate(Species = ifelse(Species %in% accepted_species_cross, Species, "other"))


df_rel_cs_all <- rel_abund_cross_cs_long %>%
  group_by(`Clinical score (0-5)`, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    total_abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(`Clinical score (0-5)`) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_abundance = total_abundance / sum(total_abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


barplot_clinical_score_all <- ggplot(
  df_rel_cs_all,
  aes(x = factor(`Clinical score (0-5)`), y = rel_abundance, fill = Species)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    x = "Clinical score (0–5)",
    y = "Relative abundance (%)",
    fill = "Species",
    title = "Species composition by clinical score all samples"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = group.colors,
    labels = function(x) {
      gsub("_", " ", sub("s__", "", x))
    }
  )
```

## Correlation clinical score and species

```{r}
#| label: rvvc-cs-species
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

###########################################
# CORRELATION CLINICAL SCORE SPECIES RVVC #
###########################################


species_corr_df <- merged_clinical_score %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Clinical score (0-5)`,
    contains("s__")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Clinical score (0-5)`))


spearman_species <- species_corr_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = contains("s__"),
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Abundance)) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    spearman_r = cor(
      `Clinical score (0-5)`,
      Abundance,
      method = "spearman",
      use = "complete.obs"
    ),
    p_value = cor.test(
      `Clinical score (0-5)`,
      Abundance,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

spearman_species_clean <- spearman_species %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(spearman_r),
    !is.nan(spearman_r),
    is.finite(spearman_r)
  )

spearman_species_clean %>%
  gt()

#write_csv(spearman_species_clean, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/correlation_clinical_score_species.csv")

heatmap_mat <- spearman_species_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, spearman_r) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Species") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mat <- spearman_species_clean %>%
  mutate(sig = p_adj_BH < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, sig) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Species") %>%
  as.matrix()


#pretty species names
pretty_taxa_names <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("s__", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x)
  x
}

#heatmap matrix
heatmap_mat <- spearman_species_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, spearman_r) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Species") %>%
  as.matrix()

colnames(heatmap_mat) <- "Clinical score"

#significance vector
sig_vec <- spearman_species_clean$p_adj_BH < 0.05
names(sig_vec) <- spearman_species_clean$Species

#rename rows after sig_vec is created
rownames(heatmap_mat) <- pretty_taxa_names(rownames(heatmap_mat))

#heatmap
heatmap_cs_species <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  name = "Spearman rho",
  col = colorRamp2(
    c(-1, 0, 1),
    c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")
  ),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "italic"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    original_species <- spearman_species_clean$Species[i]
    
    if (isTRUE(sig_vec[original_species])) {
      grid.rect(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        width = width,
        height = height,
        gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1, fill = NA)
      )
    }
  },
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Spearman rho")
)

#save heatmap
png(
  filename = "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/heatmap_clinical_score_species_spearman_2.png",
  width = 2000,
  height = 2000,
  res = 300
)

draw(heatmap_cs_species)
dev.off()

#plot
draw(heatmap_cs_species)


#CLR transformed taxa 

species_data <- merged_clinical_score %>%
  dplyr::select(contains("s__")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))
    )
  )

species_pc <- species_data + 1e-6

  compositions::clr(species_pc)

species_clr$clinical_score <-
  merged_clinical_score$`Clinical score (0-5)`

  ) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    spearman_r = cor(
      clinical_score,

      use = "complete.obs"
    ),

    p_value = cor.test(
      clinical_score,
      CLR_abundance,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )


spearman_species_clr_clean <- spearman_species_clr %>%
```

## Correlation clinical features and species

```{r}
#| label: rvvc-cs-feature-species
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

################################################
# CORRELATION CLINICAL FEATURES - SPECIES RVVC #
################################################

cross_cs_ra <- merged_clinical_score

clinical_vars <- grep("\\(y/n\\)", names(cross_cs_ra), value = TRUE)

microbiome_vars <- grep("^s__", names(cross_cs_ra), value = TRUE)

cross_cs_ra_long <- cross_cs_ra %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(microbiome_vars),
               names_to = "species",
               values_to = "abundance")

cor_results <- cross_cs_ra_long %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(clinical_vars),
               names_to = "clinical",
               values_to = "clinical_value") %>%
  group_by(clinical, species) %>%
  summarise(
    result = list(cor.test(clinical_value, abundance, method = "spearman") %>% tidy()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(result)

cor_results <- cor_results %>%
  mutate(p.adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))

write_csv(cor_results, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/correlation_species-clinical-features.csv")

sig <- cor_results %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) 

cor_results_filtered<- cor_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) %>%
  mutate(significant = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, TRUE, FALSE))


heatmap_mat <- cor_results_filtered %>%
  select(species, clinical, estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clinical, values_from = estimate, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mat <- cor_results_filtered %>%
  select(species, clinical, p.value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clinical, values_from = p.value, values_fill = 1) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mat <- sig_mat < 0.05

pretty_taxa_names <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("s__", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x)   
  x
}

rownames(heatmap_mat) <- pretty_taxa_names(rownames(heatmap_mat))

ht <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  name = "Correlation",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(
        x = x, y = y,
        width = width,
        height = height,
        gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2, fill = NA)
      )
    }
  },
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "italic"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Correlation")
)

png(
  "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/heatmap_clinical_features_species_correlation_beforeFDR.png",
  width = 2000,
  height = 2500,
  res = 300
)

draw(ht)

dev.off()

#all groups after FDR 
 sig_mat <- cor_results_filtered %>%
  select(species, clinical, p.adjust) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clinical, values_from = p.adjust, values_fill = 1) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species") %>%
  as.matrix() 
  
sig_mat <- sig_mat < 0.05
  
png(
  filename = "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/heatmap_clinical_features_species_correlation.png",
  width = 2000,

  name = "Correlation",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,

  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (sig_mat[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(

        width = width,
        height = height,
        gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2, fill = NA)
      )
    }
  },
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "italic"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Correlation")
)

draw(ht)

dev.off()

draw(ht)


#CLR transformed taxa data 
species_data <- cross_cs_ra %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(microbiome_vars)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))
    )
  )

keep_taxa <- colSums(species_data > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0

species_data <- species_data[, keep_taxa, drop = FALSE]

microbiome_vars <- colnames(species_data)

species_pc <- species_data + 1e-6

species_clr <- as.data.frame(
  compositions::clr(species_pc)
)

cross_cs_clr <- cross_cs_ra %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("s__")) %>%
  bind_cols(species_clr)


cross_cs_clr_long <- cross_cs_clr %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(microbiome_vars),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "clr_abundance"
  )

cor_results_clr <- cross_cs_clr_long %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(clinical_vars),
    names_to = "clinical",
    values_to = "clinical_value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(clinical, species) %>%
  summarise(
    result = list(
      cor.test(
        clinical_value,
        clr_abundance,
        method = "spearman",
        exact = FALSE
      ) %>%
        tidy()
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(result)

cor_results_clr <- cor_results_clr %>%
  mutate(
    p.adjust = p.adjust(
      p.value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )


write_csv(
  cor_results_clr,
  "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/correlation_species-clinical-features_CLR.csv"
)


sig_clr <- cor_results_clr %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05)

cor_results_clr_filtered <- cor_results_clr %>%
  filter(!is.na(estimate))


heatmap_mat_clr <- cor_results_clr_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(
    species,
    clinical,
    estimate
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = clinical,
    values_from = estimate,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species") %>%
  as.matrix()


sig_mat_raw <- cor_results_clr_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(
    species,
    clinical,
    p.value
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = clinical,
    values_from = p.value,
    values_fill = 1
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("species") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_mat_raw <- sig_mat_raw < 0.05

pretty_taxa_names <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("s__", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- sub("^([A-Z])[a-z]+ ", "\\1. ", x)
  x
}

rownames(heatmap_mat_clr) <-
  pretty_taxa_names(
    rownames(heatmap_mat_clr)
  )



#before FDR 
ht_clr_raw <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_mat_clr,

  name = "Correlation",

  col = colorRamp2(
    c(-1, 0, 1),
    c("#CC358A", "white", "#FF8C42")
  ),

  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {

    if (sig_mat_raw[i, j]) {

        height = height,
        gp = gpar(
          col = "black",
          lwd = 2,
          fill = NA
        )
      )
    }
  },
     row_names_gp = gpar(

    fontface = "italic"
  ),

  column_names_gp = gpar(

  ),

  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: rvvc-cs-pcoa
```

## CST types

```{r}
#| label: rvvc-cs-cst2
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

####################################
# CST VALENCIA CLINICAL SCORE RVVC #
####################################

write_csv(merged_data_CST, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/CST_over_clinical_score.csv")

#CST distribution across clinical score groups
tab <- merged_data_CST %>%
  filter(
    group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg"),
    !is.na(`Clinical score (0-5)`),
    !is.na(CST)
  ) %>%
  count(`Clinical score (0-5)`, CST) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CST, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(`Clinical score (0-5)`) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Clinical score (0-5)") %>%
  as.matrix()

#fisher exact test because some cells are likely small
fisher_res <- fisher.test(tab, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)
pval <- fisher_res$p.value

#summary table
cst_summary_clinscore <- merged_data_CST %>%
  filter(
    group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg"),
    !is.na(`Clinical score (0-5)`),
    !is.na(CST)
  ) %>%
  count(`Clinical score (0-5)`, CST) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CST, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(-`Clinical score (0-5)`))) %>%
  dplyr::select(`Clinical score` = `Clinical score (0-5)`, Total, everything()) %>%
  arrange(`Clinical score`) %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = if_else(
      row_number() == 1,
      as.character(round(pval, 4)),
      NA_character_
    )
  )

cst_summary_clinscore %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Distribution of CSTs by Clinical Score**"),
    subtitle = "Fisher exact test with simulated p-value"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    p_value = "p-value"
  )
```

```{r}
shann_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison_alpha,index = c("shannon") )
simp_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison_alpha,index  = c("simpson") )
invsimp_cross_df <- vegan::diversity(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison_alpha,index  = c("invsimpson") )
spec_cross_df <-as.numeric(vegan::specnumber(merged_samplerows_metadata_cross_sectional_comparison_alpha))
divers_cross <- as.matrix(rbind(shann_cross_df,simp_cross_df,invsimp_cross_df,spec_cross_df) )
divers_cross[is.infinite(divers_cross)] <- 0
rownames(divers_cross) <- c("Shannon","simpson","Inv Simpson","SpecNo")

  #mutate(svamp_ID=colnames(divers_cross))

divers_t_cross <- divers_t_cross %>%
  rownames_to_column("svamp_ID")

metadata_divers_cross <- sample_identification_cross %>%
  left_join(divers_t_cross, by = "svamp_ID")

metadata_divers_cross <- metadata_divers_cross %>%
  mutate(group_cross = factor(group_cross,

metadata_divers_cross <- metadata_divers_cross %>%
filter(group_cross %in% c("RVVCneg", "RVVCpos"))

  left_join(clinical_score) %>%
  filter(
    group_cross %in% c("RVVCpos", "RVVCneg"),
```

## Differential abundance analysis across clinical scores

Kruskal-Wallis across clinical scores using aldex2 differential abundance analysis

```{r}
#| label: rvvc-cs-aldex
#| echo: TRUE
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| code-fold: true

###############################################
# DIFFERENTIAL ABUNDANCE CLINICAL SCORES RVVC #
###############################################

#only estimated counts that are in clinical score selection 
estimated_counts_filtered <- estimated_counts %>%
  semi_join(
    clinical_score %>% select(svamp_ID),
    by = "svamp_ID"
  )

#join in clinical score 
aldex_data <- estimated_counts_filtered %>%
  left_join(
    clinical_score %>%
      select(
        svamp_ID,
        clinical_score = `Clinical score (0-5)`
      ),
    by = "svamp_ID"
  )


#make sure taxa data is numeric 
count_df <- aldex_data %>%
  select(starts_with("s__")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ as.numeric(as.character(.))
    )
  )


#count matrix 

count_mat <- t(count_df)

colnames(count_mat) <- aldex_data$svamp_ID

#remove taxa that are 0 in every sample 
count_mat <- count_mat[
  rowSums(count_mat) > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

#clinical score as conditions 
conds <- factor(
  aldex_data$clinical_score,
  levels = 0:5
)

stopifnot(length(conds) == ncol(count_mat))


stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(count_mat),
    aldex_data$svamp_ID
  )
)


conds <- as.character(conds)

#aldex2 clr transformation 
set.seed(123)

aldex_clr <- aldex.clr(
  reads = count_mat,
  conds = conds,
  mc.samples = 128,
  denom = "all",
  verbose = TRUE
)

#kruskal wallis 
kw_res <- aldex.kw(
  aldex_clr,
  useMC = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

kw_res <- kw_res %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "species")

write_csv(kw_res, "~/R_work/Luminal_cross_sectional/output/clinical score RVVC/aldex2_clinical_score.csv")
```
